jobs.title: Praktikum: Founder's Associate
jobs.description:
Über die Stelle

Kein Bock auf einen Job in einem Unternehmen, das es wegen KI in einem Jahr eh nicht mehr gibt? Was es dann noch geben wird: geile Snacks. Die ersetzt dir keine KI.

Genau daran arbeiten wir. SNACKL ist der herzhafte Proteinsnack, mit dem wir Deutschland eine neue Snack-Kultur geben wollen. Unterstützt werden wir von dem besten Food-VC Deutschlands, und sind auf steilem Wachstumskurs.

Bei uns verschwindest du nicht in einer Abteilung, sondern sitzt direkt neben den Gründern und siehst, wie ein Food-Startup von innen funktioniert. Als Founder’s Associate bist du unser Generalist: Du springst dorthin, wo es gerade brennt, und übernimmst Projekte von der Idee bis zur Umsetzung, egal ob Website, Marketing, Operations oder Finance. Heute baust du eine neue Landingpage, morgen vibe-codest du eine App für unsere internen Prozesse, übermorgen schreibst du Skripte für Meta-Ads und darfst beim Dreh selbst mit vor der Kamera (Wenn du es möchtest).

Wir suchen keinen Spezialisten, sondern jemanden, der Probleme löst, Verantwortung übernimmt und Dinge zu Ende bringt.

Womit du Wirkung erzielt

  • Website & Tech: Du baust und optimierst unseren Shopify-Shop mit, setzt neue Seiten und Features um und scheust dich nicht vor ein bisschen Code, auch mit Hilfe von KI.
  • Prozesse & Automatisierung: Du findest Abläufe, die noch manuell laufen, und baust sie smarter auf, von internen Tools bis zu automatisierten Workflows.
  • Wachstum & neue Kanäle: Du findest heraus, wo SNACKL als Nächstes hin sollte, rechnest es durch und bringst es an den Start.
  • Operations & Logistik: Du behältst Bestände, Nachbestellungen und Fulfillment im Blick und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Snacks zuverlässig bei Kunden und Partnern ankommen.
  • Finance & Analyse: Du unterstützt bei Reportings, Kalkulationen und Auswertungen und lernst, Entscheidungen auf Basis von Zahlen zu treffen.
  • Founder Projects: Du übernimmst strategische Sonderprojekte direkt mit dem Gründerteam, von Events bis zur Vorbereitung neuer Vertriebskanäle.

Dein Profil

  • Generalist: Du hast Lust auf viele Themen gleichzeitig und arbeitest dich schnell in Neues ein, ob Excel-Modell, Shopify-Theme oder Content-Konzept.
  • KI-affin: Du nutzt Tools wie Claude oder ChatGPT nicht nur für Texte, sondern um echte Arbeit schneller und besser zu erledigen. Erste Erfahrungen mit Vibe Coding, Automatisierung oder bauen eigener Apps sind ein großes Plus.
  • Strukturiert: Du schaffst Ordnung im Chaos, denkst in Prozessen und behältst auch bei mehreren Baustellen den Überblick.
  • Zahlenverständnis: Du hast keine Angst vor Zahlen und verstehst, was hinter einer Marge oder einer Conversion Rate steckt.
  • Echte Motivation: Du hast den Drive, Themen eigenverantwortlich voranzutreiben, und willst in einem Early-Stage Startup wirklich etwas bewegen.

Das passt zu dir, wenn...

  • ... du lieber viele verschiedene Dinge machst, als dich auf eine Aufgabe zu beschränken.
  • ... du Verantwortung suchst und auch in der „Startup-Chaos-Phase“ selbst Struktur schaffst.
  • ... du lieber schnell umsetzt und testest, als monatelang am „perfekten“ Konzept zu feilen.
  • ... du dir vorstellen kannst, später selbst zu gründen, und dir genau das aus nächster Nähe anschauen willst.

Das passt eher nicht, wenn...

  • ... du klare 9-to-5-Strukturen und ein fertiges Handbuch für jede Aufgabe brauchst.
  • ... du dich auf ein Fachgebiet spezialisieren willst und keine Lust auf Abwechslung hast.
  • ... dir Aufgaben „unter deinem Niveau“ zu schade sind, denn bei uns packt jeder überall mit an.

Was wir dir bieten

  • Output over Presence: Wir entscheiden nach Ergebnissen. Wir halten Hierarchien flach, Meetings kurz und das Tempo hoch.
  • Steile Lernkurve: Du bekommst Einblick in wirklich alle Bereiche eines Early-Stage Food Startups, von Produktion über Marketing bis Finanzierung, und lernst direkt vom Gründerteam.
  • AI-first Arbeiten: Du lernst, wie man mit modernen KI-Tools in kurzer Zeit Websites, Apps, Prozesse und Kampagnen baut, ein Skill, der dir überall Türen öffnet.
  • Community & Spirit: Du wirst Teil eines ambitionierten Teams, das den Snack-Markt nachhaltig verändern wird.

Rahmenbedingungen

Ort: Berlin (Hybrid möglich)

Anstellungsart: Praktikum (Pflicht- oder freiwilliges Praktikum, Teil- oder Vollzeit, idealerweise 3–6 Monate)

Start: Ab sofort / nach Absprache

jobs.title: Data Engineer (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
Deine Aufgaben

Als Data Engineer ist dein Job vielfältig und herausfordernd: Einerseits bist du Lösungsarchitekt und konzipierst in enger Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kunden – vom Start-Up bis zum DAX-Konzern – moderne Datenplattformen nach aktuellen Best-Practices. Andererseits bist du Entwickler, indem du deine Ideen hands-on durch eigenen Code Wirklichkeit werden lässt.

Dein Job ist getan, wenn die Rohdaten aus den verschiedensten Quellen unserer Kunden perfekt orchestrierst, verlässlich und kostenoptimiert durch das Unternehmen fließen und so die Dashboards der Kunden stets up-to-date sind.

In unseren Projekten nutzen wir insbesondere Technologien des Modern Data Stack. Bedeutet für dich, dass du innerhalb kürzester Zeit verschiedenste Lösungen rund um Tools wie dbt, Snowflake, Databricks in allen Hyperscalern wie AWS, Azure oder GCP kennenlernen und in deiner täglichen Arbeit einsetzen wirst.

Ein Auszug aus deinem zukünftigen Alltag:

  • Du arbeitest in funktionsübergreifenden Teams – gemeinsam mit Data Engineers, Data Analysts und Business People, von uns und unseren Kunden
  • Du entwirfst und entwickelst robuste und skalierende Datenlösungen entsprechend kundenseitiger Projekterfordernisse
  • Du erstellst, optimierst und orchestrierst ELT-Prozesse, um Daten aus unterschiedlichen Quellen in einem Data Warehouse zu konsolidieren
  • Du hältst mit uns gemeinsam Ausschau nach neuen Technologien und Trends
  • Du hast jeden Tag ein Team hinter dir, welches dich bei allen noch so komplexen Herausforderungen entlang deiner Projekte unterstützt

Dein Profil

In unserem Team arbeitet ein Mix aus erfahrenen und neuen Personen im Data-Umfeld. Für diese Stelle suchen wir nach jemandem, der/die bereits erste Erfahrungen in der Datenverarbeitung in der Cloud sammeln konnte und dafür brennt, die nächsten Schritte auf dem Weg zum Data-Experten zu gehen.

Perfekt wird es, wenn du folgende Voraussetzungen mitbringst:

  • Das Wichtigste: Du brennst für das Thema „Daten“ und möchtest Tag für Tag in einem hochmotivierten Team neue Dinge dazulernen
  • Du trägst das „Tüftler-Gen“ in dir und machst dich selbstständig auf die Suche nach der besten Lösung für deine aktuelle Herausforderung
  • Data Warehouse, Data Lake und Data Lakehouse sind dir ein Begriff und du verfügst über Wissen in der Anwendung von Snowflake, BigQuery oder Databricks? Chapeau!
  • Du hast hands-on Expertise im Umgang mit relationalen Datenbanktechnologien und in der Nutzung von performantem SQL
  • Du hast Kenntnisse in einer oder mehrerer Programmiersprachen, vorzugsweise Python, Java, Scala
  • Du hast bereits Erfahrung in der Implementierung Cloud-nativer Infrastruktur und kennst wesentliche Konzepte wie etwa IAM, Networking, Docker – egal ob in AWS, Azure oder GCP
  • Du hast fließende Deutschkenntnisse (mindestens C2-Niveau)

Warum wir?

Aktuell sind wir 10 Mitarbeiter*innen. Bedeutet, dass du früh an Board bist und die Gelegenheit bekommst, aktiv an der Gestaltung unseres Wachstums teilzuhaben. Was wir dir noch bieten?

  • Du wirst fester Bestandteil eines super motivierten Teams im Herzen von Oldenburg!

Join us and help make medicinal product data useful for all!

You will join our Services department, a group of interdisciplinary experts who help our pharma customers adopt our platform and make it truly useful for their data. Within it, you are part of the data engineering team, which works in a clear, well-documented way: state-of-the-art tools, flexible processes, and agentic AI used in a structured, reliable way. How you’ll make an impact:

  • You transform data from a wide range of structured sources (such as CSV, JSON, RDF, and SQL and NoSQL databases) into the IDMP data model, and build the pipelines that keep it up to date.
  • You use AI to turn unstructured sources such as documents and texts into structured, verifiable data.
  • You bring a DevOps mindset to data: with AI as your everyday tool, used responsibly, you keep data flows and tooling tested, automated, documented and reliable, as the regulated pharma industry demands.
  • You support the design of data models for IDMP knowledge graphs, leveraging the IDMP ontology, and learn to navigate graphs with SPARQL and agentic tooling.
  • As part of a joint team with our customers, you work directly with their domain experts to understand their data and make their medicinal product data useful.

What helps you succeed:

  • A background in computer science, data science or a life-science subject such as biology, chemistry or pharmacy. A formal degree is welcome but not required.

  • You understand how software and data systems fit together and can read and judge code, whether you or an AI wrote it.
  • Experience with version control (e.g. Git) and working in a team where changes are reviewed.
  • You communicate clearly with your team and with customers.
  • You live in Germany within commuting distance of Cologne and have a valid work permit.
  • Business-fluent English. German is a plus.

  • It's a plus if you have worked with RDF, SPARQL or knowledge graphs, have experience with AI-based information extraction, know the basics of data governance, or bring knowledge of the pharma domain and/or IDMP.

Why you’ll love working here:

  • Salary range of €50,000 to €80,000 gross per year, depending on experience

jobs.title: Regional Vice President, Sales Benelux & Nordics
jobs.description:
About Us

At LangChain, our mission is to enable every company to own its intelligence. We believe agents will transform how companies operate, and we're building the foundation to make that future possible. Our open-source harnesses and LangSmith platform give developers and enterprises the infrastructure to run, improve, and govern agents at scale.

We've raised $460M to date, with our most recent funding round valuing the company at $3B, backed by leading investors including Sequoia, Benchmark, IVP, and CapitalG. As we continue to expand our platform and tackle some of the hardest challenges in agent engineering, every team member has the opportunity to make a meaningful impact and help shape both our technology and the future of the industry.

More than 7,000 organizations rely on LangSmith, from fast-growing startups to Fortune 500 enterprises, including NVIDIA, Bridgewater, LinkedIn, Workday, and Rippling. We're just getting started on making high-performing agents easier to build and manage at scale.

About the role

We're hiring a Regional Vice President in EMEA to own and lead our Benelux and Nordics business. You'll inherit a team of four quota-carrying enterprise AEs across two hubs: Amsterdam and Stockholm and be responsible for building the management layer, operating model and partner ecosystem that takes both the Benelux and Nordics regions from early traction to consistent, scaled revenue.

This is a Director-level hire with second-line ambition. You'll report directly to the VP EMEA and operate with meaningful autonomy across pipeline, hiring, partner relationships and executive engagement.

 

What you'll own

Team leadership and performance

  • Lead, develop and expand the Enterprise Sales teams across Benelux and Nordics from day one

  • Run weekly pipeline reviews, deal coaching sessions and forecast calls with precision and consistency

  • Identify and close performance gaps early: coach the team to close larger deals faster and navigate complex, multi-stakeholder cycles

  • Build a culture of accountability and development; create clear career paths for senior individual contributors, including first-line management opportunities as the team scales

Revenue

  • Own the Benelux and Nordics regional number: quarterly and annual quota attainment across all two sub-regions

  • Build and maintain a healthy pipeline that supports consistent delivery and predictable forecasting to VP EMEA and leadership

  • Engage directly in strategic deals as executive sponsor, bringing credibility and commercial weight to enterprise negotiations

  • Establish the region's strongest lighthouse accounts across key industry verticals, building referenceable wins that anchor LangChain's market position in the Benelux and Nordics regions

Hiring

  • Manage multiple open roles across Benelux and Nordics simultaneously: owning the full hiring lifecycle across pipeline, assessment, and closing

  • Partner with the retained search firm and internal talent team to move at pace without compromising on quality

  • Define the headcount profile for Benelux and Nordics regions beyond Q1 and feed into H2 planning, ensuring the team is built ahead of the revenue curve

Partner ecosystem

  • Owns hyperscaler and GSI/RSI relationships (AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, and key SIs) across UKI, Nordics and Benelux

  • Develop a structured partner motion that generates qualified pipeline and supports deal acceleration, reduces risk and drives expansion

  • Represent LangChain at partner QBRs and executive engagements in region

Market presence

  • Represent LangChain as a keynote-ready leader at partner events, customer engagements, and industry conferences across the region: including KubeCon, Money20/20, Nordic AI summits and customer EBCs

  • Build LangChain's brand with technical buyers, CIOs, and innovation leaders across Benelux and Nordics most important enterprise accounts

  • Bring intelligence on the Benelux and Nordics markets back to the VP EMEA and product teams to inform roadmap and go-to-market positioning

 

What we're looking for

Experience

  • 8+ years in enterprise SaaS sales, with at least 3 years in a regional or sub-regional leadership role managing quota-carrying AEs

  • Demonstrable track record of hitting and exceeding regional revenue targets across multiple quarters

  • Experience managing teams across multiple countries and time zones, with the cultural intelligence to operate across Benelux and Nordics

  • Background selling to technical buyers (engineering leaders, CTOs, platform teams): you understand how developer tools get evaluated and adopted

  • Experience in the AI, data, or developer tooling space strongly preferred; familiarity with the LangChain ecosystem is a meaningful plus

Leadership

  • You've run teams of 6+ AEs before and know the difference between managing and coaching

  • You can hold a forecast conversation with a VP and a deal coaching session with an AE in the same afternoon and add value in both

  • You hire well and fast. You know what good looks like for enterprise AE profiles and you can run structured hiring processes across four open roles simultaneously

  • You've built or contributed to a partner motion before: you understand what "partner pipeline" means in practice, not just in theory

Operating style

  • You bias toward action. You don't wait for a playbook to be handed to you: you build it

  • You're comfortable with ambiguity and early-stage scale. This is not a role with a fully defined motion; you'll shape a significant part of it

  • You communicate clearly and directly, to your team and to leadership

  • You're present in the market. You attend the right events, know the right people and build relationships that translate into pipeline and retention

     

Compensation Philosophy:

We offer competitive compensation that includes base salary, variable compensation for relevant roles, meaningful equity, benefits, and perks.

We are hiring for this role across a range of scope, and the compensation band reflects that. Your offer depends on what we learn about your impact, craft, leadership, and communication during the interview process. We will tell you early where you’re tracking and talk comp with you before offer stage. Team members in the EU, UK, and APAC receive locally competitive benefits aligned with regional norms and regulations.

Benefits

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage, flexible vacation, a 401(k) plan, meals on in-office days in the US and more.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Developer .NET / Azure
jobs.description:
About the Company

S4D is a Software as Service (SaaS) company that provides Quick Service Restaurants (QSRs) with the omnichannel operating system to run their business in the most effective and efficient way. In other words, we help restaurants to get more orders. Our team builds and services innovative products based on the newest technologies, consisting of a wide variety of functionalities and innovative modules while offering our employees flexible working conditions. Our key values are teamwork and ownership. S4D is part of the Deloitte Technology Fast 50 and Saas100 company (selected by MT/Sprout).

About the role

We are looking for a Senior .NET Backend Developer who combines strong system design skills with a passion for engineering excellence. In this role, you will take end-to-end ownership of core backend services - driving solutions from initial architecture through deployment and production across our cloud platforms. 

Beyond shipping high-quality code, you will play a key role in raising the engineering bar across the team. You’ll mentor mid-level and junior developers, establish best practices around testability and clean architecture, and foster a collaborative environment. We also encourage our engineers to utilize modern AI developer tools (like Cursor, Claude code) to accelerate daily workflows and problem-solving.

No unsolicited services from recruitment agencies.


Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Ownership: Own backend services across their full lifecycle—from initial architectural design and technical scoping to coding, deployment, and operational health.

  • Mentorship & Team Leadership: Coach and mentor junior and mid-level developers, conduct constructive code reviews, and help elevate engineering standards across the team.

  • System Design & Architecture: Help define architectural patterns, design scalable microservices, and ensure our event-driven integration flows are resilient and decoupled.

  • Hands-on Service Development: Write clean, modular, and maintainable C# code targeting modern .NET Core runtimes.

  • Messaging & Workflows: Build robust asynchronous integrations using Azure Service Bus and MassTransit.

  • Quality & Performance: Champion automated unit testing, continuous integration, and proactive performance profiling.

  • AI-Assisted Engineering: Utilize AI coding tools to boost daily productivity and streamline system troubleshooting.

What You Bring (Mandatory) 

  • 5+ years of hands-on backend software engineering experience with C# and .NET Core.

  • Mentorship Experience: A proven track record of guiding junior/mid-level engineers, sharing knowledge, and fostering best practices (TDD, clean code, peer reviews).

  • End-to-End Feature Ownership: Demonstrated experience designing and delivering backend features from initial idea to production deployment.

  • Event-Driven Mastery: Solid understanding of microservices patterns and event-driven messaging (Azure Service Bus, MassTransit, RabbitMQ, Kafka, etc.).

  • Azure Cloud Experience: Practical experience working with core Microsoft Azure infrastructure and cloud components.

  • Testing Mindset: Deep appreciation for testable architecture and unit testing best practices.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration.

  • Knowledge of SQL Server relational database design and optimization.

  • Familiarity with modern CI/CD pipelines and DevOps workflows (Azure DevOps / GitHub Actions).

  • Hands-on experience with MassTransit specifically.

  • Experience with legacy system migration (.NET Framework to modern .NET).

  • Familiarity with developer AI tooling (e.g., Cursor, Claude code).

This is a Hybrid working model meaning you need to be at our office in Amsterdam 2-3 times a week.

jobs.description:
For this position we source for our sister company Troostwijk.

About us

Troostwijk & the TBAuctions group are part of one of Europe’s leading networks for digital B2B auctions. We market machines, vehicles, equipment and other commercial assets, bringing sellers and buyers together through digital processes and personal support.

What your day-to-day work will involve

As an Account Manager, you will develop the French seller market and act as the main point of contact for new and existing sellers. You will build a profitable portfolio, develop long-term relationships based on trust and guide opportunities from the first conversation through to active auction business.

The role combines remote work with regular travel and gives you direct influence on the development of our French market.

You will receive professional support from our teams and work with modern tools that help you structure your pipeline, follow-ups and seller relationships.

What this means in practice

  • Identify, approach and acquire new sellers in the French market.
  • Develop a profitable seller portfolio and build long-term relationships based on trust.
  • Research companies and market opportunities and turn them into relevant conversations.
  • Present our activities and value proposition clearly to business owners and potential sellers.
  • Prepare meetings, understand seller needs and agree on clear next steps.
  • Own negotiations and follow opportunities through to conversion.
  • Keep pipeline, follow-ups and seller information structured with modern tools.
  • Represent our company image and values in the market and coordinate closely with internal teams.
What matters in this role

We are looking for someone who enjoys building a market rather than only maintaining an existing portfolio. You should be comfortable creating your own pipeline, speaking confidently with business owners, handling rejection and staying focused until opportunities move forward.

What you should bring

  • Proven experience in sales, business development or new-business acquisition.
  • Experience in a technical, industrial or B2B environment with measurable commercial results.
  • Strong communication, negotiation, closing and relationship-building skills.
  • Autonomy, commercial drive, persistence and a results-oriented approach.
  • Willingness to travel regularly and a valid Category B driving licence.
  • French as a native language and the ability to work in English.

A perfect CV is less important than your ability to create relationships, develop a territory and turn commercial opportunities into long-term seller business.

What we offer

Autonomy with professional support

You will own your territory and your seller relationships while working closely with internal teams that support you with expertise, coordination and operational follow-through. You will not be left alone with complex opportunities or process questions.

Build something with visible impact

The role gives you the opportunity to help establish the French market, shape long-term seller relationships and contribute directly to recurring auction activity. Your work combines commercial ownership with professional development.

Performance that pays off

You can expect an attractive compensation package with a competitive fixed salary and a bonus model that recognises your individual performance.

Your benefits

Company car, computer, phone and meal tickets support you in your day-to-day work.

Do you have a track record in B2B sales and want to help build the French seller market? We look forward to hearing from you.

jobs.title: Location Data engineer
jobs.description:
We are seeking a highly skilled Location Data Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will work with large-scale datasets generated by our products and turn raw data into meaningful signals, insights, and features.

You will work across the entire data lifecycle: building reliable pipelines, exploring and understanding complex datasets, developing features from them, and creating the tools and visualizations needed to understand their quality and impact.

This is a technical and product-oriented data role. You'll collaborate closely with product, engineering, and data teams to find what we can learn from our data and turn those learnings into production systems.

As a Data Engineer, your day-to-day will include:

  • Making Sense of Data

    • Explore large and complex datasets to understand user behavior and identify useful patterns and signals.

    • Transform raw data into reliable, well-defined features that can be used by our products and engineering teams.

    • Develop a deep understanding of our data: where it comes from, what it represents, its limitations, and how it can be combined to answer new questions.

  • Building Data Products

    • Design, build, and maintain pipelines that process large volumes of data efficiently and reliably.

    • Take ideas from exploration to production: prototype them on historical data, evaluate their quality, and build the pipelines needed to run them at scale.

    • Build datasets and features that can power product experiences, internal systems, analytics, and machine learning models.

    • Work with technologies such as Spark, DBT, Dagster, BigQuery, ClickHouse, DuckDB, or similar tools depending on the problem at hand.

  • Exploring & Analyzing

    • Use data to investigate hypotheses, understand behaviors, and answer ambiguous questions.

    • Develop metrics and evaluation frameworks to understand whether the signals and features we build actually work.

    • Create analyses, dashboards, and visualizations that make complex datasets understandable and help the team make better decisions.

    • Build tooling that makes it easier to inspect individual examples, debug data pipelines, and understand why a system produces a particular result.

  • From Data to Intelligence

    • Work closely with engineers and product teams to identify opportunities where data can make our products smarter.

    • Use statistical methods, heuristics, experimentation, or machine learning depending on what is most appropriate for the problem.

    • Iterate on features and models based on real-world data and continuously improve their accuracy and reliability.

    • Help bridge the gap between exploratory data work and robust systems running in production.

  • Continuous Improvement

    • Improve the performance, reliability, and maintainability of our data infrastructure.

    • Monitor data quality and proactively investigate unexpected changes or anomalies.

    • Stay up to date with developments in data engineering, analytics, and machine learning, and bring relevant ideas and technologies into our stack.

    • Contribute to a culture of curiosity, craftsmanship, and learning.

Your Skills & Experience

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals and experience working with data-intensive systems.

  • Very comfortable with SQL and manipulating large datasets.

  • Experience with one or more modern data technologies such as Spark, DBT, Dagster, BigQuery, ClickHouse, DuckDB, or equivalent tools.

  • Strong analytical skills: you enjoy digging into data, testing hypotheses, and understanding why something behaves the way it does.

  • Ability to turn exploratory analysis into reliable, production-ready data pipelines and features.

  • Familiarity with data modeling, pipeline orchestration, and large-scale data processing.

  • Ability to communicate findings clearly through metrics, visualizations, dashboards, or other tools.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building data products or features directly used by consumer-facing products.

  • Experience working with high-volume event, behavioral, sensor, geospatial, or time-series data.

  • Familiarity with statistics, machine learning, or feature engineering.

  • Experience taking a data problem from an ambiguous question through exploration, prototyping, evaluation, and production.

  • Experience building internal tools or visualizations for exploring and debugging complex datasets.

Life at amo

To ensure that everyone is set up for success within our way of working, we work together onsite 5 days a week.

We wanted to make sure coming to the office was as comfortable as possible for you:

We chose a location in central Paris, near Opéra (Metro lines 3, 8, 9 and RER A).

We have a beautiful Parisian-style office with high ceilings, balconies, and huge windows. So a lot of natural light!

Because life outside of work should also be stress-free, we cover:

  • Health care (100% coverage).

  • Maternity Leave, Paternity Leave, Second Parent Leave (salary maintained at 100%).

  • Vacation days: 8–9 weeks (total) per year:

  • 1–2 additional weeks (RTT, based on our company contract);

  • ~11 bank holidays.

We shut down entirely twice a year, two weeks in summer and one week in winter, to allow everyone to truly recharge and avoid prolonged slowdowns. These pauses are part of your total vacation time, giving everyone a real chance to unplug and recharge. No Slack, no email, no FOMO.

  • ML engineers and data scientists who moved into LLM work as it matured.

😕 Probably not a fit

Insurance hasn't changed much in over a century. The way we live, work and travel has. We're building the real-time, AI-driven infrastructure that powers innovative insurance, so good drivers get cover that works the way they actually drive.

We're not just updating insurance; We're leading the AI evolution in insurance 🤖

  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS) and tools like Docker or basic pipeline orchestration.

About the Role at RobCo

RobCo is building the category of Autonomous Industrial Robotics and we're doing it fast. We believe that automating the ordinary frees humans to do the extraordinary, and we're building the end-to-end robotics infrastructure to make that possible - hardware, software, and AI in one stack that just works.

 

At RobCo, we automate the ordinary, so humans can do the extraordinary. To achieve this, we are looking for an ambitious (Senior) Technical Program Manager (m/f/d) to help us establish RobCo as leading provider of automation solutions.

As a (Senior) Technical Program Manager (TPM) at RobCo, you take responsibility for overseeing and managing multiple complex robot deployment projects simultaneously. You actively contribute to shaping the structures and processes that drive our projects to success. Your goal is to ensure that all your projects are delivered efficiently, on time, and in line with the highest quality standards.

Your Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Program Ownership: You are responsible for multiple strategically relevant robotics deployment programs simultaneously – from pre-sales alignment and technical solution design through implementation to successful handover into operational business.

  • Building Scalable Structures: You develop governance frameworks, reporting standards, and delivery processes that enable fast, high-quality growth. In doing so, you establish best practices for future programs.

  • Strategic Stakeholder Management: You act as a sparring partner to C-level executives, customers, and internal leadership teams. You create transparency regarding progress, risks, dependencies, and business impact, and make data-driven decisions.

  • Technical and Commercial Steering: You maintain oversight of both technical integration details and commercial aspects such as budgets, margins, resource planning, and business cases, ensuring projects are delivered successfully from a financial perspective.

  • Risk and Escalation Management: You identify systemic risks at an early stage, initiate preventive measures, and manage escalations in a structured and solution-oriented manner.

  • Innovation and Continuous Improvement: You analyze recurring patterns, identify optimization potential, and actively drive automation and standardization of our deployment processes.

We're looking for someone who has:

  • Excellent German and English language skills, both are critical.

  • Completed technical university degree (e.g., Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science) or equivalent qualification with significant technical professional experience

  • 5+ years of experience managing complex technical programs, ideally in robotics, automation, industrial tech, or hardware-software integration

  • Proven experience in building scalable project or deployment structures in a high-growth environment

  • Strong systems understanding of mechatronic or cyber-physical systems

  • Ability to abstract technical details to an executive level and translate them into business impact

  • Confident presence when interacting with customers, management, and external partners

  • Experience with budget responsibility, resource planning, and commercial management

  • Structured, data-driven working style combined with pragmatic execution skills

Why join RobCo?

  • Develop modular, software-defined robotics solutions with us that set new standards in automation.

  • Help us build robots equipped with state-of-the-art AI that perceive their environment, analyze data, and make intelligent decisions in real time.

  • As part of a very dynamic and fast-growing scale-up, you will take on responsibility from day one, drive your own projects, and see the direct impact of your work.

Founded in Munich in 2020, RobCo leads the transition toward fully Autonomous Industrial Robotics. Our mission is to deploy RobCo in every factory - solving the industrial labor shortage through end-to-end robotics that just works. Condukt is the next-generation compliance platform for financial services, offering an agentic solution powered by real-time data for business identity.

Always-on and policy-aware, Condukt enables financial institutions and fintechs to gain actionable insights into business verification - unlocking growth, increasing efficiency, and strengthening compliance.

Trusted by leading regulated entities, including Wise, Tide, Mollie, Shift4, Flatpay, and myPOS, Condukt is backed by top investors, including Lightspeed Venture Partners and MMC Ventures.

We’re looking for a Senior Compliance Consultant to help our clients navigate regulatory change, horizon-scan upcoming regulation, and overcome regulatory challenges so they can transform their businesses and meet their strategic growth objectives.

This is a versatile, high-impact role at the intersection of regulation, client advisory, practical delivery and product strategy. Your mission is to deeply understand our clients’ needs and regulatory obligations, and to deliver solutions that help them achieve their compliance and business outcomes. You’ll stay ahead of the risk and compliance landscape, translating regulatory change into clear guidance for our customers and concrete requirements for our Product team.

Whether you’re shaping a client’s regulatory strategy or influencing our product roadmap, you’ll bring deep knowledge and hands-on experience of financial crime compliance, along with strong commercial awareness. Acting as an in-house consultant, you’ll connect long-term regulatory horizons with granular operational realities.

 

As an early-stage, fast-growing company, we value people who take ownership, move comfortably between complex challenges, and have the judgement to turn them into sharp, practical solutions. You’ll also work on long-horizon strategic projects, such as building government relationships and expanding Condukt’s global data footprint, where progress is measured in weeks, not months.

If you thrive in dynamic environments where no two days look the same, enjoy tackling a constant stream of new and complex problems, and want to help shape how financial institutions and fintechs approach compliance, this role is for you.

 

What you’ll do:

  • Act as Condukt’s subject matter expert on KYB/KYC and AML/CFT, giving clients clear, commercially minded advice on their regulatory obligations

  • Lead client engagements end to end, from understanding the business challenge and assessing current controls to designing solutions that combine Condukt’s platform with third-party providers and supporting their implementation

  • Partner with Product to translate regulatory and client needs into the signals, data and capabilities we build

  • Contribute to business development and thought leadership with a clear, well-argued point of view on regulation, through proposals, client pitches, whitepapers, briefings, webinars and industry events

 

What you bring:

  • 4+ years’ experience in financial crime compliance, gained in a consultancy, a regulator or a regulated financial services firm

  • Deep domain expertise in risk and compliance, ideally across KYB/KYC, AML/CFT or business onboarding in financial services

  • A track record of advising financial institutions and fintechs on risk, compliance or regulatory matters, with a toolkit of structured frameworks you can adapt to a fast-growing company

  • Experience leading client engagements and producing polished, client-ready deliverables

  • Experience advising on vendor assessment and selection, including running or contributing to RFP processes

  • Proven ability to build trusted relationships with C-suite stakeholders, regulators and government agencies

  • Strong commercial awareness: you can turn regulatory requirements into solutions clients see real value in

  • A legal background, or solid working knowledge of financial regulation and how legislation translates into operational requirements

  • Sound judgement and tact in sensitive situations: you know what to communicate, to whom and when

  • The analytical rigour to dig into complex legislation and question established interpretations

  • A self-starter mindset that thrives in fast-moving, high-ownership environments

Bonus:

  • Experience in government relations or regulatory affairs

  • Prior experience in fintech, banking, payments or compliance infrastructure

  • Early-stage startup experience

  • Second language proficiency (German, French, and Dutch, especially valued)

 

Our offer:

  • Tackle meaningful problems with real-world impact

  • Competitive salary and equity package

jobs.title: Sales Team Lead
jobs.description:
About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.

Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.

We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.

We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded.

Where we are today:

  • Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers

  • Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond

  • 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai

  • $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW

The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth.

The Sales Team Lead is a pivotal commercial role responsible for leading, coaching, and developing a sales team. The position focuses on driving sales performance, optimizing pipeline management, and ensuring operational excellence to support sustainable revenue growth.

You will work closely with Sales Leadership and cross-functional teams to execute strategic initiatives, maintain KPI ownership, and foster a high-performance culture. This role is ideal for a hands-on leader who thrives in fast-paced environments, enjoys developing top talent, and brings a strong commercial mindset.

We offer a clear career growth path, competitive compensation with performance-based incentives, and the opportunity to make a meaningful impact at our Berlin headquarters, backed by leading international investors.

Key Responsibilities

1. Sales Performance & Operations

  • Drive commercial performance and contribute to sustainable revenue growth.

  • Lead day-to-day sales execution and monitor weekly and monthly KPIs.

  • Own pipeline management and ensure accurate, disciplined forecasting.

  • Maintain visibility over pipeline health, market developments, and overall sales performance.

  • Collaborate with Sales Leadership to improve sales processes and operational efficiency.

  • Implement and reinforce best practices, reporting standards, and performance tracking to ensure consistent execution.

2. Team Leadership & Coaching

  • Lead and inspire a high-performing sales team in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment, setting clear expectations and standards for success.

  • Drive a strong performance culture built on accountability, consistency, and continuous improvement.

  • Coach and develop team members through regular 1:1s, deal reviews, live feedback, and hands-on support.

  • Partner with Sales Leadership on hiring, onboarding, and developing top talent to ensure long-term team strength.

  • Identify growth opportunities within the team and actively support career development and internal progression.

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistent achievement of sales targets and pipeline objectives.

  • A highly engaged and high-performing sales team.

  • Strong forecasting accuracy and operational discipline.

  • Improved sales productivity, conversion rates, and overall team efficiency.

Who You Are

  • 4–6+ years of experience in B2B sales, business development, or sales leadership roles.

  • Proven experience managing, mentoring, or coaching sales teams in fast-paced environments.

  • Strong understanding of sales KPIs, pipeline management, and sales operations.

  • Familiarity with CRM systems; experience with Salesforce is a plus.

  • Additional European language (German, Italian, or French) is a strong plus.

  • Comfortable working in a high-performance, office-based environment.

jobs.description:
Help Us Build The Future of Travel

At Airalo, we're making it easier for people to stay connected wherever they travel. As the world's first eSIM store, we help millions of travelers access affordable mobile data in 200+ countries and regions around the world.

Today, we're a team of 400+ people across 60+ countries, building a product used by travelers every day. We've grown quickly, but we've worked hard to keep what matters: trust, ownership, and the freedom for people to do great work without unnecessary layers or bureaucracy.

We're fully remote by design, genuinely global, and united by a shared mission to make travel simpler for everyone.

Your Next Destination

  • Location: Remote.
  • Contract: Full-time, permanent.
  • Benefits: Learn more about our benefits here in this link - https://airalo-public.notion.site/Benefits-25396a97ffca81fb9bc1f0be479f1be3?pvs=74 
  • Languages: English is our main working language day to day, so you'll need to be comfortable communicating in it both in meetings and async.

 


Airalo's fully remote Data team is growing, and so is our ambition for how we measure marketing. You'll help Airalo decide where to invest the next dollar by owning how we measure marketing performance: attribution, the data models behind it, and incrementality testing that shows what really works, turning evidence into investment decisions across the globe.

You'll pair solid measurement expertise, including causal inference, with strong core analytics. You'll guide teams on what to measure and test, defend our framework with senior stakeholders, and make sure data changes decisions. This is a small, growing team and a capability that is new to the business: you'll build the process, not inherit it. Expect your time to be split between measurement work (attribution, data modelling and incrementality) and the day-to-day analytics Growth and Marketing rely on.


What You'll Do
  • Support our marketing attribution models and methodology: review how conversions are credited across channels, reconcile platform-reported and first-party numbers, and keep the approach trusted and documented.
  • Design and maintain the marketing data models behind measurement (spend, attribution, orders and customer cohorts) with Analytics Engineering, with clear definitions, tests and documentation.
  • Support Growth and Marketing with ad-hoc and core analytics, such as campaign and market performance, self-serve dashboards and AI-assisted analytics.
  • Design and run geo experiments from simulation-based power analysis and market selection to success criteria and read-out, working with the marketing performance team.
  • Co-own a prioritised quarterly incrementality test roadmap across channels and markets, ranked by decision value, cost, feasibility (including properly powered tests) and learning, and track each test through to a decision.
  • Handle spillover, seasonality and small-market noise, and report incremental CAC and incremental ROAS with honest uncertainty.
  • Turn test results into investment guidance: estimate marginal returns and saturation by channel and market, and recommend where the next dollar should go and where to pull back.
  • Help set and document our causal measurement standards: which method when, what counts as sufficient evidence, and how results calibrate attribution and MMM for budget allocation.
  • Defend the framework under challenge from channel owners and leaders, and pressure-test platform claims.
  • Guide Growth, Acquisition and Finance from business question to testable hypothesis to budget decision, and build literacy on attributed versus incremental performance.
  • Build reusable experiment tooling and templates, work with Analytics Engineering and MarTech on the data experiments needed, and document every test and decision as you build this capability from scratch.

    • What You'll Bring
  • 3+ years of experience in marketing measurement (attribution, incrementality or marketing mix modelling), with a track record of analysis that changed real budget decisions.
  • Solid grounding in causal inference and experimental design: randomised and quasi-experimental methods such as synthetic control and difference-in-differences, simulation-based power analysis to size and design tests, and knowing when each approach breaks.
  • Strong statistical judgement: you can quantify uncertainty, explain it simply, and resist overclaiming.
  • Hands-on experience with marketing attribution models and their limits, including reconciling platform-reported results with first-party data.
  • Familiarity with how experiments calibrate MMM and attribution, and with marginal-return and budget-optimisation thinking (saturation, diminishing returns).
  • Expert SQL and Python, production-quality code, a modern warehouse (BigQuery or Snowflake) and a BI tool such as Lightdash or Looker.
  • Strong data modelling skills: designing clean, tested and documented models (dbt or similar) for marketing spend, attribution and customer data, and working closely with Analytics Engineering.
  • Strong core analytics skills: marketing and customer metrics (CAC, LTV, retention, funnel and cohort analysis), dashboards and self-serve BI, and the judgement to prioritise ad-hoc requests alongside the test roadmap.
  • Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders: you hold a position under challenge, have shaped a roadmap, and say no with a clear rationale.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and with data that is still improving: you're a proactive self-starter who is happy to create a new process or capability in a small, fast-growing team.

    Why People Join Us

    We started Airalo to make staying connected effortless, wherever you are in the world. Today, millions of travelers rely on our eSIMs, and many of the people building the product were customers first.

    Our team spans 60+ countries, united by a shared belief that great work happens when people are trusted to own what they do. There's trust to own what you do, space to focus without constant layers of process, and a clear sense of what you're responsible for from day one.

    As Airalo continues to grow, so do the opportunities to learn, take on new challenges, and make a real impact - from anywhere in the world.

We are looking for a Confirmed Backend Engineer to join the Care team at BlaBlaCar.

As part of the Corporate Services pillar, your mission will be to empower our Community Relations Team (CRT) with the tools they need to have a 360-degree view of the user journey across our platform.

Avec une équipe 100% internalisée et des bureaux à Paris, Londres, New York, Hong Kong et Shanghai, nous concevons des solutions sur mesure qui transforment les données en impact positif concret, grâce à une combinaison unique de technologie et de services.
 
Notre force est de déployer une IA à impact, à grande échelle. Notre mission : mobiliser cette puissance pour répondre aux défis les plus urgents de notre temps. Nous nous engageons pour une IA responsable et frugale, pour garantir un impact constant à grande échelle, et pour rester fidèles à nos valeurs et à notre ADN.  

Pourquoi recrutons-nous ?

Pour accompagner notre forte croissance, nous sommes à la recherche d’un.e Stagiaire Data Scientist avec une appétence technique et marketing/stratégie.

Notre positionnement unique sur le marché vous permettra d’allier des compétences techniques telles que l’économétrie, l’économie, les statistiques et les mathématiques appliquées avec de la programmation. Il vous permettra également de développer des compétences en stratégie, conseil et marketing afin de répondre au mieux aux problématiques business de nos clients.

Votre rôle dans l’équipe :

Votre rôle dans l’équipe : 

• Manipuler des bases de données, cleaning, avec l’utilisation d’outils adaptés  comme Python et/ou Excel. 

•  Analyser des données et réaliser des modèles  d'économétrie, statistiques bayésienne etc. 

• Analyser et construire la stratégie marketing et optimisation media en s’appuyant sur les modèles  

• Participer également à la construction des livrables et à la présentation des recommandations à nos clients  

Profil recherché : 

• Vous êtes diplômé(e) d’une école d’ingénieur généraliste ou d’une école de commerce.

• Vous avez de bonnes bases en programmation, ainsi qu'une expérience en Python et avec les modèles de data science. 

• Vous savez analyser des données et les transformer en recommandations stratégiques pour répondre aux enjeux business. 

• Votre curiosité, votre esprit analytique et votre aisance en communication vous permettent de collaborer efficacement avec différentes parties prenantes.

• Une expérience académique ou professionnelle sur Databricks/Azure est un plus.

  Notre processus recrutement
  • Un test technique sur HackerRank
  • Un entretien RH avec un(e) Talent Acquisition
  • Une étude de cas
  • Un entretien final

Chez Ekimetrics, vos idées comptent vraiment et vous appartiennent — à vous de leur donner vie. Nous cultivons un esprit entrepreneurial qui vous encourage à repousser les limites pour créer un impact significatif. 
 
Mais il ne s’agit pas seulement de réussites individuelles : nous avançons ensemble, en nous enrichissant mutuellement. jobs.title: Senior Talent Acquisition Partner – DACH
jobs.description:
Agicap is one of Europe's fastest-growing fintech scale-ups. Our platform helps mid-market companies manage cash, liquidity and financial operations, combining treasury management, accounts payable and accounts receivable in a single tool. Founded in Lyon in 2016, Agicap serves over 8,000 customers in twelve countries, with about 650 people across Lyon, Berlin, Milan, Madrid, Lisbon, London and the US.

Germany is one of our main markets. Our Berlin office at Moritzplatz is home to around 100 people, and DACH remains a top priority for our growth.


The role :

We are looking for a Senior Talent Acquisition Partner to own hiring for our DACH scope from our Berlin office. You will run the full cycle, from hiring need to offer, for business roles in Germany, mainly Sales and Customer Success, plus a few senior or expert positions.

This is a senior individual-contributor role. You will be the go-to recruiter for DACH and a sparring partner on hiring plans and profiles. Reporting to the Global Head of TA, you will join a team that works across seven markets and shares playbooks, tools and projects.


What you'll do :

Hiring delivery

  • Own end-to-end recruitment for DACH roles: intake, job description, sourcing, screening, process management, closing and following offer.

  • Hit monthly hiring targets for Sales (SDR, Account Executive) and Customer Success roles, and take on senior or strategic DACH hires.

  • Source passive candidates proactively on LinkedIn and other channels, with sharp outreach in German and English.

  • Assess candidates against clear scorecards and coach them through each stage.

    • Partnering with the business

  • Act as a trusted advisor to DACH hiring managers and leaders: challenge profiles, set realistic hiring plans, and push for fast, fair decisions.

  • Bring market insight to every intake: talent availability, competitor landscape, salary benchmarks and candidate expectations in DACH.

    • Process, data and brand

  • Track and report your pipeline and KPIs: time-to-hire, conversion rates and quality of hire.

  • Spot friction in the candidate journey and interview process, then test and roll out improvements.

  • Strengthen Agicap's employer brand in Germany: content, referrals, events and partnerships.

  • Contribute to global TA projects, such as AI in recruiting, playbooks and onboarding of new recruiters.


    • What you bring :

    Must-haves

  • 5+ years of full-cycle recruiting, ideally combining agency and in-house at a tech, SaaS or fintech scale-up.

  • Strong active-sourcing skills: Boolean search, LinkedIn Recruiter, a headhunter mindset.

  • Credibility with senior stakeholders: you can push back, influence and drive decisions.

  • A data-driven approach: you use funnel metrics to steer your work and your hiring managers.

  • Native or bilingual German and fluent English.

    • Nice-to-haves

  • A proven track record of hiring Sales and Customer Success profiles in Germany, at volume and at senior levels.

  • Hands-on use of AI tools in sourcing, screening or reporting.

  • Experience with Lever or a similar ATS.

    • How you work

  • Autonomous and hands-on: you own your scope without daily supervision.

  • Resilient in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

  • Candidate-centric: fast, objective and transparent processes are your standard.


    • What we offer :

  • Salary : 60-70k base according to profile and experience. (70-85k OTE)

  • Prime office location: a large, modern office at Moritzplatz, Berlin, with a terrace, snacks and drinks.

  • Meal & grocery allowance: up to €108/month tax-free via the Hrmony app.

  • Tenure rewards: a €30 monthly shopping voucher after one year and up to two extra vacation days.

  • Team culture: an international TA team across seven markets, global offsites and local team events.


    • Recruitment process :

    1. Screening call with one of our TA Team Leads (30/45 min).

    2. Interview with the Global Head of TA (45/1 hour).

    3. Case study with our CPO.

    4. In-offce interview to meet our business leaders, and the TA team onsite.

    5. Reference checks.

Ready to work somewhere that cares more about how you build software than how fast you can ship it?

At Opencast, we don’t measure developers by the number of tickets you complete. We care about engineering craft, clean design and thoughtful problem-solving. 

Opencast consultants deliver in complex environments, pairing often and working with others who take pride in doing things properly: TDD, emerging design, refactoring and leaving code better than they found it. We build software we are proud of, and our clients trust us not just to code but to think, challenge and guide. If you value simple and robust solutions and want a role where your judgment matters as much as your keyboard, you will fit right in.

The role

We’re looking for Contractors in Software Development (Senior level or Technical Lead) to help our major clients transform. 

Software developers at Opencast care about building products right and combine their own experience and approach with our company values. They are tech agnostic, have expertise in agile methodologies, extreme programming practices and use industry-leading programming languages to deliver agile transformation.

Our approach to software development is collaborative, focused on keeping things simple, and we use test driven development and pair programming as best practice.

Working with clients and key stakeholders is a crucial part of a consultancy role. Our developers are inclusive team players that listen, collaborate, can positively challenge and manage expectations when needed but most of all are always willing to teach and help others. Leaving a client with improved ways of working, working technology and a good experience from discovery through to live is the priority.

Contractors at Opencast follow the same principles as permanent consultants. The roles are varied, technical, and never confined to any one provider or solution.

Requirements

Due to the nature of this role, applicants must either currently hold active Security Check (SC) Clearance or be eligible to obtain it.

Eligibility typically requires UK citizenship and continuous residence in the UK for the past five years, with no single absence exceeding 28 consecutive days.

As attendance at client sites is a routine part of the role’s working pattern and involves occasional travel, travel expenses are not covered.

Experience in delivering digital services for the UK government is highly valuable for many of our projects. Therefore, familiarity with the GDS toolkit will be beneficial.

Technical Skills

  • Expertise in Java and/or Scala is required
  • Experience in other languages such as Javascript, Typescript, Kotlin, Python or Ruby is also valuable
  • Experience in a technical leadership role
  • Deep understanding of programming paradigm, code design, testing, accessibility, performance and security
  • Proven ability to apply different testing tools and methods in practice
  • Knowledge or experience of delivering complex services to Government Digital Service (GDS) standards
  • Being comfortable with new technology, t-shaped and comfortable with ongoing learning and development is key to success
  • Experience with agile methodology

A contractor in software development at Opencast is responsible for:

  • Driving the elaboration of their team’s backlog
  • Setting testing strategies to match industry standards
  • Being a technical expert in their team (or acting as the team lead)
  • Leading the technical representation in a project discovery
  • Acting as a technical lead in the team, enabling them to achieve their full potential

Salary 

£450 - £600 per day (working inside IR35)

Where you’ll work 

This role requires regular on-site attendance across our HQ, hub offices, client sites and home. Applicants must be able to commute to offices and client sites as part of their normal working arrangements, as travel is essential to fulfilling the responsibilities of the role.

We include you 

We welcome candidates from all identities, attributes, ways of thinking and backgrounds to thrive in a career at Opencast. Our aim is for the diversity of our people to be reflected in the solutions we deliver, to help create a fairer society for all.   

Interview 

Interviews will be conducted via Microsoft Teams. We’re happy to make adjustments to support your needs.

jobs.title: Quality Control Specialist (Software/Electronics)
jobs.description:
Join the Wingtra team and become part of this venture-backed robotics scaleup with a global and international team of 125+ dedicated Wingtranauts who want to see their actions have a positive and lasting impact on the world. Founded more than 8 years ago at ETH Zurich, Europe’s leading robotics university, our goal is to build the best aerial robots to digitize the world at the push of a button and set the basis for faster and better decisions. Wingtra provides efficient and reliable data solutions to a variety of industries ranging from mining, construction and agriculture to humanitarian organizations, environmentalists and wildlife monitoring groups.

We are reaching for the stars and together we might just get there. Open communication, asking hard questions and valuing diverse viewpoints are but a few things that will help us achieve our goals. Above all we will never stop learning and striving to help each other reach our maximum potential.

When a drone fails a test on our production floor, you're the first person we call. As Production Quality Control Specialist (Software/Electronics), you're the first line of technical support for production. You troubleshoot, diagnose and fix failures across our VTOL drones, their sub-systems, sensors and in-process quality tests. That way every aircraft we ship meets the standard our customers rely on in the field.

You also step back from single failures and look at the data. You analyze yields and quarantine trends, find the root causes behind repeat problems and decide which fixes to tackle first. You work closely with Production, Engineering and Supply Chain, and your work shows up directly in product quality and output.



 


Responsibilities

  • First on the scene. You're the first-line technical support for production issues, from test failures and assembly defects to nonconforming units.

  • Fix what's broken. You troubleshoot and repair electrical, electronic and system-level failures on drones, sub-assemblies, payloads and sensors.

  • Keep the test benches honest. You help investigate issues with our software and electronics test benches.

  • Decide what happens to quarantined material. You choose whether it gets reworked, repaired, scrapped or returned to the supplier.

  • Find the real cause. You lead root cause analyses (5 Whys, Ishikawa, 8D) on recurring and high-impact failures.

  • Let the data point the way. You analyze yields and quarantine Paretos to spot the biggest quality drivers.

  • See fixes through. You turn your findings into prioritized corrective actions (CAPA) and follow them until they are closed.

  • Keep failure, test and repair records traceable.

  • Share what you learn. You feed findings back to Engineering and suppliers, and you train assembly staff on failure modes and workmanship defects.


    • Requirements

  • You've spent 4+ years as a quality technician, quality inspector or assembly technician on a complex mechatronic product.

  • You understand at system level how mechanics, electronics, sensors and firmware work together.

  • You're at ease with data. You can build yield and failure Paretos and draw sound conclusions from them.

  • You're motivated and able to get to know our test software stack.

  • You're methodical and keep good records, and you make sound calls under production pressure.

  • You have a technical apprenticeship or technical diploma in Engineering, Manufacturing or Mechatronics, or equivalent practical experience.

  • You communicate excellently in English and enjoy working together on the shop floor.


    • Plus

  • Experience with UAVs, RC aircraft or avionics

  • Familiarity with batteries, GNSS, IMUs, cameras or LiDAR

  • Experience designing electronics PCBAs

  • Experience in software programming

  • SPC, Cp/Cpk, MSA or a Six Sigma Green Belt

  • Python, SQL, BI or AI tools for data analysis

  • Experience with non-conformance tracking, quality management systems or manufacturing ERP/PLM software

  • Familiarity with inspection tools, measurement equipment, technical drawings and CAD

  • Hands-on work with assembly line operators, manufacturing engineers and quality teams

  • Continuous improvement methods such as 8D, 5S and CAPA

  • Speaking or understanding German

    • Joining Wingtra, you gain deep insight into applied robotics and aerial photogrammetry. You work in a startup, so you make a personal impact on both the technology and the organization itself.

Unsere Mission ist einfach: Wir möchten Menschen dabei unterstützen, Daten zu verstehen. Wir sind der Meinung, dass Unternehmen, die Daten sinnvoll einsetzen, bessere Zukunftsaussichten haben als andere und haben bereits Kunden wie PwC, Rheinenergie, Johnson & Johnson, Fielmann, Volkswagen und DZ Bank dabei geholfen, Datenvisualisierung und Datenintegration mit den führenden Produkten Tableau und Alteryx zu optimieren.

Innerhalb von 4 Monaten erhältst du eine intensive und umfangreiche Ausbildung in unserer fantastischen Data School im Zentrum von Hamburg. Und das Beste daran? About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

 

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

 

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

 

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 

The Role

BJAK is building a Neobank Superapp for Southeast Asia. As a Technical Product Manager, you’ll own a product vertical end to end—such as payments and expense management, remittance, insurance, or wealth and trading—from strategy, outcomes, and roadmap through to the technical design and delivery of the systems behind it.

 

This is a product where real money moves, mistakes are immediately visible, and licensing, compliance, and third-party rails are core product constraints—not considerations around the edges.

 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where a model can genuinely improve an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted when money is involved.

 

What you'll be doing

  • Own a vertical end-to-end — outcomes and metrics, a backlog prioritised by value / risk / dependency / strategic priority, acceptance criteria crisp enough to build and test against.

  • Shape the technical design with engineering — system boundaries, money-movement correctness (idempotency, ledgering, reconciliation), third-party-rail reliance and rail-down behaviour, failure/retry/refund paths, security, latency, scalability, recovery.

  • Make hard trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability and UX — and defend them to an engineering, compliance or ops lead who pushes back.

  • Treat regulated constraints as first-class product inputs — licensing scope, CDD/KYC and limits, sanctions/PEP screening, transaction monitoring, data residency and privacy. Know which are hard launch gates and which are forward-readiness.

  • Apply AI where it earns its place — define what it's allowed to decide, where a human stays in the loop, how it's evaluated, and what it does when unsure. Every AI-surfaced number traces back to a real record.

  • Ship against external gates — build feature-complete behind flags; go live per rail as each partner and regulatory gate clears.

  • Work across Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance/Reconciliation.

     

What you'll need

  • Product leadership — significant experience owning a complex technical product end-to-end; strong judgement and decisiveness under ambiguity; ability to balance ambition against technical, regulatory and operational reality; can hold their own with senior engineers.

  • Technical foundation — solid system design (boundaries, datastores, queues/workflows, APIs, failure modes, consistency under concurrency); comfort reading, reviewing and challenging design docs; can sketch an architecture and a sequence. No production code, but technical enough that engineers don't have to simplify.

  • Domain — experience in a regulated / high-consequence domain (payments, banking, remittance, insurance, …) or demonstrable fast-ramp ability; understands why money movement is different (correctness over convenience, irreversible states, partners you don't control).

  • AI judgement — hands-on with LLM-based products; can frame a feature as eval-able (offline, online, human feedback); realistic on hallucination/drift/data gaps, including data-blocked vs model-blocked and when a model must not be in the loop at all.

  • Nice to have — engineer or highly-technical-PM background · zero-to-one · shipped AI-heavy consumer products · defined eval metrics for ML/LLM systems · AI UX + failure-handling intuition · SEA market experience.

     

Outcomes

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

     

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Germany. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Germany.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 
 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

You will design the detailed mechanics of how users interact with A1 - the gestures, states, flows, and micro-decisions that determine whether an AI-driven product feels controlled or confusing.

This role is focused on HCI interaction design: how users give input, receive feedback, supervise AI actions, correct mistakes, and maintain agency over AI-driven workflows.

There are no established playbooks for interaction design in proactive AI products. You will help define new patterns from the ground up.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Design detailed interaction models for AI-driven flows, including how users initiate, monitor, pause, correct, and complete multi-step tasks.

  • Define interaction states for AI interfaces: idle, thinking, acting, waiting, uncertain, interrupted, failed, and recovered.

  • Design human-in-the-loop controls - how users review AI decisions, override actions, and stay informed without micromanaging.

  • Create interaction patterns for delegation, approval, correction, escalation, reversibility, and recovery.

  • Create detailed interaction specifications, annotated flows, and prototypes for engineering handoff.

  • Work with product and ML teams to translate system capabilities and constraints into usable interaction patterns.

  • Test interaction designs with real users to identify where AI behavior creates confusion, distrust, or friction.

  • Contribute to a shared library of HCI interaction patterns that can be reused across the product.

What You Will Need

  • Experience as an interaction designer or senior UX designer with strong interaction design depth.

  • Ability to design at the micro level - states, transitions, edge cases, and failure handling.

  • Strong prototyping skills in Figma or equivalent tools.

  • Systematic thinking - able to map complex AI behavior into coherent user-facing interaction logic.

  • Clear understanding of HCI principles: user control, transparency, feedback, and graceful recovery.

  • Experience working closely with engineers to ensure interactions are implemented as designed.

  • Comfort designing for systems where output is non-deterministic and behavior can vary across sessions.

  • Strong judgment on when users should be guided, interrupted, asked for confirmation, or left alone.

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.

 

Role

  • Build and maintain cross-platform desktop applications using Electron, TypeScript and React

  • Develop interfaces for messaging, real-time collaboration and AI-powered features

  • Implement desktop functionality including file system access, notifications, auto-updates and deep linking

  • Integrate backend APIs and WebSockets for real-time messaging, presence and streaming responses

  • Manage local storage, application state and message history

  • Optimise application startup time, memory usage and runtime performance

  • Debug production issues and maintain application stability across macOS and Windows

 

Requirements

  • 3+ years of software engineering experience, including building production Electron applications

  • Strong proficiency in JavaScript, TypeScript and React

  • Experience with Electron architecture, main and renderer processes, and IPC communication

  • Experience integrating REST APIs, WebSockets and real-time data updates

  • Understanding of desktop application lifecycle, native OS integrations and application packaging

  • Experience with local storage technologies such as SQLite, IndexedDB or file systems

  • Strong debugging and performance profiling skills across macOS and Windows

 

Nice to Have

  • Experience building chat, messaging or collaboration applications

  • Experience with Electron auto-updates, code signing and application distribution

  • Experience integrating LLM APIs, AI agents or streaming AI responses

  • Experience with native Node.js modules or platform-specific integrations
