jobs.title: Responsable de projet - Espace de confiance Pro Santé Connect H/F (CDD public de 3 ans)
jobs.description:
L'Agence du Numérique en Santé (ANS) accompagne la transformation numérique du système de santé en France. Aux côtés de ses partenaires institutionnels et professionnels, elle contribue à sécuriser les échanges de données de santé, à développer l'interopérabilité et à promouvoir des services numériques au bénéfice des professionnels et des usagers.

Au cœur de ces enjeux, Pro Santé Connect (PSC) est le service de fédération d'identité du secteur de la santé. Il permet aux professionnels d'accéder de manière sécurisée aux services numériques de santé grâce à une authentification adaptée à leurs besoins. Pour accompagner le développement de cet écosystème, l'ANS développe l'Espace de confiance Pro Santé Connect (EDC PSC). Ce dispositif vise à permettre aux solutions numériques en santé de se raccorder à Pro Santé Connect et à leurs utilisateurs d'accéder aux services numériques dans des conditions maîtrisées de sécurité et de confiance. Il repose sur plusieurs dimensions complémentaires : interopérabilité technique, exigences de sécurité, référencement, qualification, accompagnement des acteurs et surveillance dans la durée.

Dans ce contexte, nous recherchons notre futur(e) Responsable de projet transverse, chargé(e) de porter la vision globale de l'Espace de confiance et d'en coordonner le développement et le fonctionnement.

🎯 Vos missions

En tant que Responsable de projet transverse, vous êtes garant(e) de la cohérence globale de l'Espace de confiance Pro Santé Connect. Vous définissez sa trajectoire, coordonnez les différentes expertises mobilisées et veillez au bon fonctionnement de l'ensemble du dispositif.

À ce titre, vous :

  • Définissez et portez la vision du dispositif : construisez la vision cible et pilotez la feuille de route de l'Espace de confiance.

  • Garantissez sa cohérence globale : veillez à l'articulation entre les référentiels, les parcours de référencement, les services techniques et le fonctionnement opérationnel.

  • Coordonnez les différents chantiers : organisez les dépendances, facilitez la collaboration entre les parties prenantes et veillez à la bonne articulation de leurs contributions.

  • Pilotez le fonctionnement du dispositif : consolidez les indicateurs de suivi, identifiez les points de vigilance et préparez les décisions et arbitrages nécessaires.

  • Animez la gouvernance : organisez le fonctionnement global de l'Espace de confiance et contribuez aux instances de pilotage.

  • Pilotez l'amélioration continue : organisez la collecte et la prise en compte des retours des éditeurs et partenaires afin de faire évoluer le dispositif.

Vous évoluez dans un environnement qui distingue volontairement la définition des exigences, l'accompagnement des acteurs, l'évaluation de conformité, l'expertise et la décision de référencement. Cette organisation vise à garantir l'impartialité et la confiance dans le dispositif.


💼 Votre profil

  • Vous disposez d'une expérience confirmée d’au moins 5 ans dans le pilotage de projets, produits, services ou programmes numériques complexes, impliquant plusieurs expertises et parties prenantes.

Vous êtes notamment reconnu(e) pour votre capacité à :

  • Construire une vision cible, définir des orientations et élaborer une feuille de route

  • Piloter des sujets transverses et coordonner plusieurs chantiers interdépendants

  • Faire travailler ensemble des équipes et des organisations aux expertises variées

  • Identifier les dépendances, prioriser les actions et préparer les arbitrages

  • Assurer le suivi d'un dispositif à travers des indicateurs pertinents et des instances de gouvernance

  • Communiquer avec clarté, synthétiser des sujets complexes et adapter votre discours à des interlocuteurs spécialistes comme non spécialistes

Vous disposez également d'une bonne compréhension des enjeux liés à l'identité numérique, à l'authentification, à la cybersécurité et à l'interopérabilité

Les connaissances suivantes seraient un plus :

  • Le secteur du numérique en santé et ses principaux acteurs institutionnels

  • Les mécanismes de fédération d'identité et les services d'authentification

  • Le standard OpenID Connect

  • Les environnements réglementaires et de sécurité : PGSSI-S, RIE, règlement eIDAS et directive NIS2

·         Motivation à évoluer dans un secteur porteur et en pleine transformation.

Chez Novar, nous ne vous proposons pas seulement un emploi – nous vous invitons à rejoindre une véritable aventure. Vous travaillerez dans un environnement entrepreneurial et innovant, où l’énergie est au cœur de tout – au sens propre comme au sens figuré. Chez Novar, nous croyons que l’avenir de l’énergie est vert – et nous le concrétisons. Depuis notre création en 2014 aux Pays-Bas, nous sommes devenus un acteur majeur du développement et de l’exploitation de grandes installations d’énergies renouvelables. Avec plus de 150 collaborateurs engagés et 800 MWc de capacité installée, nous faisons avancer la transition énergétique à pleine vitesse. 

 

Ce qui a commencé par des centrales solaires au sol est devenu une entreprise énergétique complète. Aujourd’hui, nous développons et fournissons de l’énergie solaire, du stockage par batteries, du solaire thermique, de l’hydrogène, des réseaux intelligents et bien plus encore. Nous couvrons toute la chaîne de valeur – du développement et de la construction à la gestion de l’énergie et à l’innovation. 

 

Depuis 2024 nous étendons nos activités au-delà de notre marché d’origine, avec une présence en Suède, en Allemagne et en France. Notre objectif est ambitieux : développer 4 gigawatts de systèmes énergétiques verts d’ici 2030. Wir suchen Persönlichkeiten, die etwas bewegen möchten und Interesse daran haben, sich fachlich wie persönlich weiterzuentwickeln.

Das solltest du mitbringen:

  • Ausgeprägtes Interesse an Finanzthemen, Investments und wirtschaftlichen Zusammenhängen.

Für diese Position im Rahmen eines einmonatigen Praktikums mit einer wöchentlichen Arbeitszeit von 40 Stunden erhältst du eine monatliche Vergütung zwischen 400 und 3.200 €.

jobs.title: Developer Community Lead
jobs.description:
About RhymeQ

RhymeQ is on a mission to make quantum programmable for every developer. Today, developing quantum software often requires deep physics expertise and code tailored to specific hardware. We’re removing these barriers so developers can focus on solving problems.

Headquartered in Karlsruhe, Germany, we bring together an international team with an open mindset, an energetic team spirit, and a shared drive to build something that matters. We value initiative, ownership, and collaboration, giving everyone the space to contribute ideas, take responsibility, and help shape the future of quantum programming.

Your role

As our Developer Community Lead, you will help developers discover, write their first quantum program, and keep building. Your goal is to turn early interest into an active community where developers learn from one another, share projects, and contribute to the product’s development.

You will combine technical education, community building, and developer outreach. Working closely with our founders and engineering team, you will shape the community experience and grow the community internationally to our target size.

What you will do

  • Grow an active developer community: Build relationships with universities, programming communities, quantum organizations, and event organizers to attract developers to RHYME.
  • Help newcomers succeed: Create a clear onboarding journey, from registration and installation to running and sharing a first quantum program.
  • Build reasons to return: Organize onboarding cohorts, office hours, coding challenges, and hackathons that encourage continued learning and participation.
  • Create useful technical content: Develop tutorials, sample projects, livestreams, posts, and talks that make quantum programming approachable.
  • Support community contributions: Encourage developers to share their work, answer questions, and help others. Identify and support potential community ambassadors.
  • Connect developers with the product team: Turn questions, feedback, and recurring problems into clear recommendations for the compiler, tooling, and documentation.
  • Measure what works: Track acquisition, activation, retention, and contributions, and use the results to improve community programs.

What you bring

  • Bachelor’s in computer science, PhD is preferred.
  • Over 2 years of experience growing a developer community for a technical product, with results you can demonstrate through active users, downloads, contributors, event participation, or other relevant measures.
  • Practical Python skills. You can run code examples, lead a live tutorial, and help a newcomer troubleshoot their setup.
  • The ability to explain technical concepts clearly and make learning engaging, whether in writing, on camera, or on stage.
  • Strong written and spoken English and confidence working with an international audience.
  • A self-driven approach: you can set priorities, organize programs, deliver them, and learn from the results.
  • An open, supportive communication style that helps developers feel comfortable asking questions and sharing unfinished work.
  • An understanding of quantum computing fundamentals, or the motivation to learn them quickly.

Your ability to build trust with developers, teach through code, and grow sustained participation matters most.

What we offer

  • Ownership from the start: Shape our community strategy, programs, and developer experience as our first community hire.
  • Direct collaboration with the founders: Work closely with the people building RHYME and bring developer needs into product decisions.
  • An open, international team: Share ideas, experiment, and learn alongside colleagues who value initiative and collaboration.
  • Visible impact: Help developers move from curiosity about quantum computing to building their own applications.
  • Remote work within Europe.

As a Senior AI Product Manager, you move plancraft closer to becoming the autopilot for the trades: Evolving our product from software that helps tradespeople manage their work into one where AI agents can take on meaningful parts of their daily workload.

This is not about adding AI features to an existing roadmap. jobs.title: Head of Talent Development
jobs.description:
Hi, we’re Back Market.

We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new. We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new.

Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have.

Are you ready to join us?

At Back Market, we're on a mission to prolong the life of electronics — because a phone that's already been made is always smarter than making a new one. With around 700 Backmakers across Paris, Bordeaux, Barcelona, New York, and Tokyo, we're growing fast, and our People ambition is growing with us.

We're redesigning how the People function works from the inside out — dedicated expertise hubs, one shared language for hiring, assessing, developing, and promoting. The Talent hub brings Talent Acquisition and Talent Development under one roof, and we're looking for the person who will own the development side of that equation.

You'll own Back Market's Talent Development practice end to end — connecting performance, careers, skills, learning, and succession into one system that managers actually use and Backmakers actually trust.

  • Redesign our learning offer — who learns what, when, and through which channel — while delivering priority programmes for managers and teams in the meantime

YOU ARE IN THE RIGHT PLACE IF ⭐

You have:

Nice to have:

RECRUITMENT PROCESS:

  • Call with Julie, Senior Talent Acquisition Partner (45min)

  • Back Market Values fit interview (45 min)

ABOUT THE ROLE:

  • Head of - Management role

WHY SHOULD YOU JOIN US ? ✌🏼

At Back Market, we’re committed to hiring and supporting diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives — it’s one of the reasons we’re such a high-scoring certified B Corp company (93.2).

No matter your role and seniority level, you’ll enjoy impact-driven work with hands-on career development in an innovative, driven, and fast-paced environment — with benefits to match, like:

At Back Market, we strive to create a workplace that embodies the world we’re trying to change. We’ve embedded our diversity, equity, and inclusion principles into our DNA — from dedicated staff to employee resource groups to our company values.

We know that the perfect background for a role doesn’t mean the perfect fit — we encourage you to apply for a role even if you think you may not have all the qualifications.

jobs.title: Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
About finmid

At finmid, we’re building infrastructure that integrates access to capital for SMEs directly into the platforms they use daily. We leverage technology, data, and strategic partnerships to deliver financing solutions that significantly outperform traditional financial services - offering SMEs faster, simpler, and more transparent access to funding.

As we expand across Europe, our Latvian subsidiary, licensed as a European Crowdfunding Service Provider by the Bank of Latvia, plays a critical role. Our stack combines regulated financial infrastructure with modern software engineering. The gap between those two things is exactly where this role lives.

The Role

We're looking for a Platform Engineer who wants to own the infrastructure that makes everything else possible. You'll build and maintain the systems our engineering teams rely on every day — CI/CD pipelines, cloud infrastructure, data tooling, AI integrations, and developer experience as a whole. This isn't a "keep the lights on" role. You'll design systems from scratch, introduce new tools, and have a direct say in how we build software.

What You Will Work On

  • Architect and manage our cloud infrastructure on AWS and Kubernetes.

  • Build and improve CI/CD pipelines, developer tooling, and internal platforms.

  • Evaluate, integrate, and roll out new tools and services across the company.

  • Own production systems end-to-end — from design decisions to incident response.

  • Raise the bar on security, observability, and engineering standards.

We care far more about how you think than what you already know. Languages and tools can be learned — curiosity and drive can't.

Dein Profil

  • Strukturierte und eigenständige Arbeitsweise sowie die Bereitschaft, technische Lösungen und Wissen nachvollziehbar zu dokumentieren und weiterzugeben.

  • Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit Hardwareentwicklung und technischen Fachbereichen sowie Interesse daran, Software direkt am realen System zu testen.

Nice to have

jobs.title: Marketing Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Wir sind experics, eine mehrfach ausgezeichnete Boutique-Agentur für SEO und GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) aus Lingen. Mit über 200 betreuten Websites und Online-Shops, durchschnittlich mehr als 11 Jahren Erfahrung pro Consultant und dem European Search Award 2025 gehören wir zu den erfahrenen Spezialisten für organische Sichtbarkeit in Google und KI-Systemen wie ChatGPT oder Google Gemini. Durch diese Fachkenntnis sorgen wir dafür, dass mittelständische Unternehmen in Google und KI-Systemen gefunden, empfohlen und gekauft werden.

Unsere Expertise ist längst da. Was noch fehlt, ist die entsprechende Sichtbarkeit am Markt.

Bisher kümmert sich unsere Geschäftsleitung nebenbei um das Eigenmarketing. Doch wir haben größere Ziele. Und dafür brauchen wir dich.

Du bekommst die Chance, unser Marketing nicht einfach nur zu betreuen, sondern aktiv aufzubauen und strategisch weiterzuentwickeln. Mit deinen Ideen und deiner Expertise sorgst du dafür, dass unsere fachliche Stärke endlich auch in unserer Außenwahrnehmung sichtbar wird. Dabei genießt du echten Gestaltungsspielraum, arbeitest eng mit der Geschäftsleitung zusammen und kannst auf die Unterstützung erfahrener externer Spezialisten zurückgreifen.

Aufgaben

  • Events und Messen: Du planst unsere Auftritte auf Konferenzen und Messen und organisierst eigene Formate wie unseren experics Strategietag. Von der Idee über Location, Einladungen und Dienstleister bis zur Nachbereitung begleitest und koordinierst du den gesamten Prozess.

  • E-Mail-Marketing und Leadmagneten: Du baust unser E-Mail-Marketing aus, entwickelst Leadmagneten wie unseren AI Search Blueprint weiter und richtest Nurturing-Strecken ein, die aus Interessenten Gesprächstermine machen.

  • Thought Leadership: Du übersetzt das Wissen unserer Consultants in Inhalte, die der Markt liest. Fachartikel, PR, Beiträge in Fachmedien und Ghostwriting für den LinkedIn-Account unseres Geschäftsführers.

  • Social Media: Du betreust unsere eigenen Kanäle, allen voran LinkedIn, und erstellst Grafiken und Short-Videos selbst. Das notwendige Equipment und die technischen Voraussetzungen stellen wir dir selbstverständlich zur Verfügung.

  • Bewertungen und Kundenstimmen: Zufriedene Kunden soll man auch sehen. Du verantwortest unser Bewertungsmanagement und betreust einen festen Ablauf, mit dem wir regelmäßig Bewertungen und Kundenstimmen einholen und sinnvoll einsetzen, etwa auf der Website, in Angeboten und auf LinkedIn.

  • SEO und GEO in eigener Sache: Du sorgst dafür, dass experics in Google und in KI-Suchen so gut gefunden wird wie unsere Kunden. Das Handwerk dafür lernst du direkt von unseren Consultants.

  • Schnittstelle zu Dienstleistern: Du steuerst externe Partner wie Event- und Designagenturen oder unsere Beratung für Verkaufspsychologie und hast Budget und Zeitplan im Blick.

Qualifikation

  • Erfahrung: Du bringst 2 bis 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Marketing mit, idealerweise im B2B und am liebsten mit Agenturhintergrund.

  • Sprache: Du schreibst auf Deutsch auf sehr hohem Niveau. Deine Texte sind klar, kommen auf den Punkt und brauchen kein Lektorat. Englisch ist ein Plus.

  • Design und Video: Du arbeitest sicher mit Canva, Adobe oder Figma und produzierst Social-Media-Grafiken und Short-Videos selbst.

  • Events: Erfahrung in der Organisation von Events oder Messeauftritten ist ein klares Plus.

  • Lernbereitschaft: SEO- und GEO-Grundwissen ist willkommen, aber kein Muss. Entscheidend ist, dass du den Ehrgeiz mitbringst, dich in neue Themen einzuarbeiten und dein Fachwissen kontinuierlich auszubauen. Schließlich sind SEO und GEO unsere Kernthemen, die du auch nach außen vertreten wirst.

  • Eigenverantwortung: Du steuerst deine Themen selbst, triffst Entscheidungen und kommst nicht mit jeder Kleinigkeit zur Geschäftsleitung.

  • Haltung: Du bist zuverlässig, packst an und suchst Lösungen statt Gründe, warum etwas nicht geht.

Benefits

  • 30 Tage Urlaub

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Ob private Termine, Sport oder persönliche Verpflichtungen – dank unserer Kernarbeitszeit von 10 bis 15 Uhr kannst du deinen Arbeitstag besser an dein Leben anpassen.

  • Sicherer Arbeitsplatz: Du erhältst eine unbefristete Festanstellung in unserem Büro in Lingen und profitierst vom direkten Austausch mit deinem Team.

  • Kurze Entscheidungswege: Deine Ideen landen nicht in endlosen Abstimmungsschleifen. Du arbeitest direkt mit der Geschäftsleitung zusammen und kannst eigene Projekte schnell und eigenverantwortlich umsetzen.

  • Lernen von Top-Experten: Du arbeitest mit einigen der besten Berater Deutschlands zusammen, beispielsweise aus den Bereichen Verkaufspsychologie und Eventmarketing, und profitierst unmittelbar von ihrer Erfahrung und ihrem Fachwissen.

  • Budget für externe Spezialisten: Du musst nicht alles allein stemmen. Für die Umsetzung deiner Marketingprojekte steht dir ein Budget zur Verfügung, mit dem du bei Bedarf externe Experten einbinden kannst.

  • Fachwissen mit Zukunft: Du erhältst tiefe Einblicke in SEO, GEO und KI-Suche und baust dir wertvolles Know-how in Bereichen auf, die für das digitale Marketing zunehmend an Bedeutung gewinnen.

  • Zusätzliche Benefits: afs+ Mitgliedschaft, betriebliche Krankenversicherung, Deutschland-Ticket, Corporate Benefits und weitere attraktive Mitarbeiterangebote.

  • Gemeinsame Erlebnisse: Regelmäßige Team- und Unternehmensevents, bei denen auch der persönliche Austausch nicht zu kurz kommt.

Bitte nur bewerben, wenn du:

  • mindestens 2 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Marketing hast

  • auf Deutsch auf sehr hohem Niveau schreibst

  • in Vollzeit vor Ort in Lingen arbeiten möchtest

  • an einer langfristigen Zusammenarbeit interessiert bist

Schick uns gern 2 bis 3 Arbeitsproben mit, zum Beispiel Texte, Grafiken oder ein Event-Konzept, das du verantwortet hast.

Deine Ansprechpartnerin ist Larissa Möller.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer, Startups (Codex)
jobs.description:
About the team

The Applied AI Engineering team works closely with frontier startups. We are trusted advisors to, and thought partners with, startups to ensure that OpenAI’s technology is deployed safely and effectively, whilst also partnering with engineering, research, and product to turn those insights into evaluation systems, product improvements, and better model behavior.

This team sits at the intersection of customer reality and model quality. We combine hands-on technical depth with strong product judgment, helping translate complex, high-value use cases into clear signals that can improve both the customer experience and the underlying systems.

About the Role

As an Applied AI Engineer focused on Codex for startups, you will help developers and founders transform how they build and ship software. You’ll combine hands-on engineering, startup experience, and compelling technical communication to help teams turn the potential of AI coding tools into practical, effective workflows.

Presentations and community engagement are central to this role. You will engage developers and founders through technical talks, live demos, workshops, and programmes across the startup ecosystem, alongside targeted work with individual customers. You’ll build reusable tools and resources that extend your impact, and bring insights from developers back to OpenAI’s Product, Research, and Engineering teams.

This role is well suited to someone who enjoys both hands-on building and sharing what they learn with others. You should be as excited to lead a room of developers, deliver an engaging presentation, and build relationships across the startup community as you are to explore a technical problem in code—with a focus on sustained adoption and meaningful improvements in how startups work.

In this role, you will:

  • Partner with top startups to identify where Codex can have the greatest impact on how their teams build and ship software.

  • Design and lead technical talks, live demos, workshops, hackathons, and repeatable hands-on programmes that turn initial interest into sustained adoption.

  • Work directly with selected customers to build Codex workflows, integrations, and automations, resolve technical blockers, and evaluate effectiveness and reliability.

  • Turn successful approaches into reusable code examples, guides, and tools that help more startups succeed with Codex and OpenAI’s broader platform.

  • Collaborate with account teams, developer experience, and ecosystem partners to reach developers and founders, prioritise opportunities, and drive measurable customer value.

  • Translate customer experiences and developer feedback into actionable insights for OpenAI’s Product, Research, and Engineering teams.

You’ll thrive in this role if you:

  • Have experience building at, founding, or working closely with early-stage startups, and understand the pace, ambiguity, and practical trade-offs involved.

  • Bring strong software engineering fundamentals and enjoy building practical AI applications, integrations, and developer tools.

  • Are an active user of Codex or other AI coding tools, with a thoughtful perspective on how they can improve software development.

  • Are a compelling communicator who enjoys presenting, delivering live demos, and leading hands-on workshops for developers and founders.

  • Have a talent for turning complex technical ideas into clear explanations, engaging examples, and reusable resources that help others succeed.

  • Combine developer empathy with sound technical judgment: you can uncover what a team needs, troubleshoot problems, and help them adopt effective, reliable workflows.

  • Bring high agency, curiosity, and end-to-end ownership, working independently while collaborating closely with colleagues and ecosystem partners.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement.

Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.

To notify OpenAI that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this link.

OpenAI Global Applicant Privacy Policy

At OpenAI, we believe artificial intelligence has the potential to help people solve immense global challenges, and we want the upside of AI to be widely shared. Join us in shaping the future of technology.

jobs.title: Expansion manager France / Développeur.se Immobilier - Nord et IDF
jobs.description:
Rejoins Fastned pour accélérer la transition énergétique ! En tant qu’Expansion Manager, tu contribueras à notre croissance en France sur des sites clés et tu nous aideras à atteindre notre objectif de 1 000 stations. Aux côtés de +450 collègues avec +50 nationalités, répartis dans 10 pays, nous impulsons le changement dans la transition énergétique. Ce qui nous distingue : notre engagement envers la fiabilité, la durabilité et l'énergie propre. Nous avons récemment été reconnus « Meilleur réseau de recharge » au Royaume-Uni, en France, en Suisse et aux Pays-Bas. C'est l’opportunité de créer un impact durable !

Le rôle

Fastned France est en pleine expansion, et en tant qu'Expansion Manager, tu seras un.e acteur.rice clé de cette croissance.

Tes futures missions :

  • Identifier de nouveaux terrains pour y implanter nos stations de recharge rapide.

  • Analyser les nouveaux sites et monter les dossiers, d’un point de vue économique et juridique.

  • Nouer des relations commerciales avec divers types de propriétaires fonciers.

  • Négocier et conclure des contrats de bail.

  • Suivre et coordonner le développement des projets, de la signature des accords jusqu'à l’ouverture des stations.

  • Coordonner avec les services internes le bon déroulement des projets.

  • Cultiver et développer ton réseau, représenter Fastned lors d’évènements extérieurs.

Tu intégreras l’équipe chargée de l’expansion en France, tout en collaborant avec des expertes et experts en architecture, construction, branding et data.

Grâce à ton réseau dans l'immobilier, tu renforceras notre maillage territorial en créant de nouvelles opportunités avec des propriétaires fonciers, des promoteurs et développeurs immobiliers. Tu mèneras des négociations stratégiques, en incarnant les valeurs de Fastned, et veilleras à ce que chaque projet se développe de manière fluide.

La mobilité électrique est un domaine nouveau pour toi ?

Pas de problème ! Dans le cadre de ton intégration, tu participeras à une série d’onboardings passionnants où tu apprendras tout ce qu’il faut savoir sur le monde de l’e-mobilité et de la recharge.

Ce que nous recherchons

Tu aimes prendre des initiatives, tu n’as pas peur de faire des erreurs et tu as soif d’apprendre ? Si tu coches également les cases suivantes, alors postule ! 

  • Tu vis dans la région parisienne et tu y as déjà un réseau conséquent;

  • Tu as +3 ans d’expérience en développement immobilier ou d’enseignes ;

  • Tu es intéressé.e/animé.e par la transition énergétique ;

  • Tu as le contact facile, capable de nouer des relations durables ;

  • Tu as l’habitude de prendre la voiture pour visiter un site en pleine campagne et le train pour venir au bureau à Paris régulièrement ;

  • Tu as de solides compétences en matière de négociation et de communication ;

  • Tu comprends et sais t’exprimer en anglais ;

  • Tu as un permis de conduire valide afin de monter à bord de ta voiture de fonction électrique et voir nos beaux projets se concrétiser partout en France !

Nos avantages

Chez Fastned, on travaille avec ambition pour avoir un impact réel, et on prend le temps de reconnaître et célébrer nos réussites, qu’elles soient grandes ou petites. On valorise l’équilibre vie pro / vie perso, on t’offre une vraie flexibilité de travail et nous mettons en place des initiatives family-friendly.

Nos avantages :

  • Un budget formation et développement de 3 000€ brut par an par collaborateur, car le développement et la formation sont importants pour nous et notre secteur offre des opportunités infinies.

  • Voiture de fonction électrique avec frais de recharge couverts.

  • Carte Ticket Restaurant, 12,20€ par jour. 

  • 25 jours de congés + RTT + 2 jours de Mission Days que tu peux utiliser pour contribuer aux missions de Fastned et soutenir une cause associative qui te tient à cœur.

  • Fastned prend en charge 60 % de ta mutuelle Alan et 100 % de ton salaire pendant les 30 premiers jours d’absence pour maladie/incapacité de travail.

  • Un abonnement Gymlib avec accès à un large réseau de salles de sport et studios.

  • Plan de stock options -> nous croyons à la création de valeur partagée.

  • Bien-être mental avec nilo health : accès à une plateforme de santé mentale confidentielle offrant des séances de coaching individuel avec des psychologues, des sessions de groupe et une variété d’outils.

  • Des événements festifs: Ski trip, Fastned Days, team buildings - des temps forts pour se retrouver, échanger et célébrer nos réussites.

Envie d'en savoir plus ?

On serait ravis d'avoir une conversation avec toi ! Envoie-nous ton CV et dis-nous en plus, pourquoi Fastned, et pourquoi toi.

Le processus de recrutement se déroule en 4 étapes :

  • Entretien vidéo avec notre recruteuse ;

  • Entretien vidéo avec la Lead Expansion France et un Expansion Manager

  • Case study vidéo avec la Lead Expansion France, et deux membres de l’équipe ;

  • Team coffee chats dans nos locaux parisiens pour rencontrer les collègues de l’équipe France.

Nous attendons ta candidature ! Si tu as des questions ou que tu as besoin de plus d'informations concernant ta candidature, veuillez contacter notre équipe de recrutement via ----- style="text-align:justify;min-height: 1.7em;">

Fastned est synonyme d'équité et d'inclusion. Nous accueillons les candidatures de personnes de tous horizons, identités de genre, orientations sexuelles, religions, neurodiversités, handicaps, situations familiales ou toute autre caractéristique protégée qui te rend unique.

jobs.title: Senior Client Partner – Steuerlösungen Public Sector (w/m/d), 80–100 %
jobs.description:
Information Factory steht für Management Consulting, Technologie und datenbasierte Lösungen. Für die Betreuung führender kantonaler Steuerverwaltungen und die Weiterentwicklung unserer etablierten Steuerlösungen suchen wir eine Persönlichkeit, die Kundenbeziehungen, Fachprozesse und Technologie miteinander verbindet.

Deine Mission

Du gestaltest langfristige Kundenbeziehungen, entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden fachlich-technische Roadmaps und sorgst dafür, dass unsere geschäftskritischen Lösungen nachhaltigen Nutzen schaffen. Dabei verbindest du Lösungsdesign, Betrieb, Sicherheit, Organisation und die Perspektive der Fachbereiche.

 

Deine Aufgaben

  • Wichtige Kundenbeziehungen im kantonalen Steuerumfeld betreuen und weiterentwickeln

  • Client-Success-Pläne mit messbaren Ergebnissen und klaren Review-Punkten entwickeln

  • Kundennutzen, Adoption und Beziehungsqualität steuern und Risiken früh erkennen

  • Fachlich-technische Mehrjahres-Roadmaps mit Fachbereich, IT, Betrieb und Management erarbeiten

  • Bestehende Steuerlösungen und das Lösungsportfolio im Public Sector weiterentwickeln

  • Informationssicherheit, Auditierbarkeit, Business Continuity und hohe Verfügbarkeit einbeziehen

  • Neue Vorhaben identifizieren und Angebote gemeinsam mit dem Account Management entwickeln

Zusammenarbeit mit Solution Delivery

Du verantwortest Kundenbeziehung, Kundenergebnisse, Adoption, gemeinsame Roadmap und Account-Entwicklung. Der Solution Delivery Manager verantwortet Umsetzung, Umfang, Termine, Budget, Qualität, Releases und Betriebsbereitschaft. Gemeinsam sorgt ihr für realistische Zusagen und klare Erwartungen.

Das bringst du mit

  • Mehrjährige einschlägige Erfahrung oder einen gleichwertigen Leistungsausweis mit komplexen strategischen Kunden

  • Nachweisbare End-to-End-Verantwortung für ein geschäftskritisches System oder eine vergleichbare Lösungslandschaft im Betrieb

  • Erfahrung mit Roadmaps, Zielbildern oder Transformationsvorhaben

  • Praxis in einem regulierten, auditpflichtigen oder hochverfügbaren Umfeld

  • Ausgeprägte Beratungs-, Kommunikations-, Stakeholder- und Moderationsfähigkeiten

  • Unternehmerisches Urteilsvermögen mit Fokus auf langfristigen Kundennutzen

  • Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch, mindestens C1, und Englisch mindestens B2

  • Bereitschaft zu regelmässigen Kundenterminen in der Schweiz

Besonders wertvoll

Erfahrung im Schweizer Steuerwesen, in einer kantonalen Verwaltung oder im weiteren Public Sector ist ein starker Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung. Die Steuerdomäne kann aufgebaut werden. Ebenfalls wertvoll sind Kenntnisse von eGovernment, eCH-Standards, Informationssicherheit, öffentlicher Beschaffung, HERMES oder regulierten Hochverfügbarkeitsumgebungen.

Was dich erwartet

Sinnstiftende Arbeit an langfristigen Lösungen für Bürgerinnen, Bürger und Behörden, direkter Austausch mit Entscheidungsträgern und Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen Kolleginnen und Kollegen aus Consulting, Engineering, Delivery und Betrieb. Der Schwerpunkt liegt auf Kundenergebnissen und langfristiger Account-Entwicklung, nicht auf quota-getriebenem Vertrieb.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
Finom is a fast-growing European tech startup, headquartered in Amsterdam, on a mission to revolutionize the financial landscape for entrepreneurs globally. We are developing an all-in-one financial B2B solution that seamlessly integrates banking functions, accounting, financial management, and invoicing into a mobile-first platform.
 
Following a significant €115 million Series C equity round, bringing our total funding to approximately $346 million, we are expanding aggressively across key EU markets (Germany, France, Netherlands, Italy, Spain). We go beyond traditional banking, offering invoicing and a growing suite of features, including AI-enabled accounting, to simplify financial management for small and medium-sized businesses.
 
At Finom, we empower our employees to make a real difference. We nurture an innovative and inspiring environment where bold ideas thrive, prioritizing thorough research, swift implementation, and ensuring every effort benefits our users, partners, and our business as a whole.
 
Engineering Manager - Product
 
We're looking for an Engineering Manager who's both a technical leader and a product builder. You'll guide a cross-functional team (5-10 engineers across backend, frontend, mobile, and QA) in delivering products that create real value for hundreds of thousands of businesses across Europe.

What You Will Be Doing
  • You're a seasoned technical leader with strong engineering roots and a track record of building teams that ship products that matter. You communicate clearly with everyone – engineers, product managers, executives – and you're genuinely curious about the product, the users, the business, and how your team's work drives real impact.
  • You don't just manage delivery. You challenge problem framing with your PM partner, ensure the team solves the right problems, and think in terms of business outcomes, not just technical outputs. You're comfortable discussing retention and conversion funnels alongside system architecture. You help the team understand ROI and prioritize based on value and effort.
  • You have deep technical expertise and can still step in to unblock when needed. You balance feature delivery with technical debt, keeping scalability in mind while ensuring the team ships at pace. You make technical decisions through explicit trade-offs, not gut feelings, and help everyone understand the "why" behind choices.
  • You take ownership of both outcomes and people. You run meaningful 1:1s, create growth plans, and own hiring and promotions. You build engaged teams through honest feedback and coaching. You invest in making the team more productive – better tools, smarter processes, fewer bottlenecks.
  • You drive predictable delivery by partnering tightly with Product and Design. You communicate proactively about priorities, risks, and constraints. You encourage healthy debate and move toward "disagree and commit" when needed.

    • Who You Are
  • 5+ years of software development building data-intensive production systems
  • Proven track record leading cross-functional engineering teams
  • Deep technical knowledge: hands-on experience with at least one of the common general-purpose languages and platforms (C#/.NET, Java/JVM, JavaScript/Node, Go), distributed architectures, databases, messaging and queueing systems.
  • Experience in product-led organizations, ideally with international scopeStrong business acumen – you connect engineering work to revenue, retention, and trust
  • Comfortable with product metrics (DAU/MAU, retention, conversion funnels)
  • Exceptional communication in English across all audiencesA builder's mentality: you care about shipping great products and growing great teams

    • Our tech stack

     

  • Backend: .NET Core, PostgreSQL, Redis, RabbitMQ, Kafka, Kubernetes

  • You'll lead teams using React, Swift/Kotlin, Python/ML frameworks, and modern QA tools

    • What You Will Get In Return
     
    Make a genuine impact on the product
     
    We're a growing fintech serving hundreds of thousands of European businesses. You'll lead a domain team with real ownership and autonomy over what you build and how you build it. This is a place for curious leaders who want to grow as technical managers, product thinkers, and people leaders.
     
    Work in the EU
     
    Embark on this exciting journey with us and enjoy the flexibility of traveling and working remotely or in a hybrid model across Europe.
     
    Become a stock options holder
     
    Unlock your inner entrepreneur and align your aspirations with ours through our Stock Options Program. This exciting opportunity is available to every team member, from junior team members to our founders.
     
    Receive unwavering support and care
     
    Finom stands by you at every step, embodying our commitment to your well-being and success reflected in our modern, friendly, and eco-conscious corporate culture. We offer constant support and care to ensure your Finom experience is successful and fulfilling.
     
    Work & Swim program
     
    Immerse yourself in our exclusive Work & Swim Program. Spend one month in a comfortable corporate apartment in enchanting Cyprus. It's the ideal opportunity to strike the perfect work-life balance while enjoying breathtaking Mediterranean views.
     
    Equal Opportunity Statement 
     
    At Finom, we're an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We embrace diversity and invite applications from all walks of life. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability status, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

jobs.description:
Als global tätiges EnerTech-Unternehmen verbinden wir Energieversorgung, Technologie und Services. Unser Ziel ist es, mehr Menschen Zugang zu modernen Energielösungen zu ermöglichen. Dafür bieten wir Stromtarife aus 100% erneuerbaren Energien an, installieren Wärmepumpen und entwickeln smarte Tarife.
 
Dabei sind unsere Ökostromtarife nur die Basis. Bereits seit 2022 installieren wir Wärmepumpen-Komplettlösungen mit eigenen Fachkräften. Außerdem arbeiten wir aktiv an der flächendeckenden Einführung von Smart Metern, Elektromobilitätslösungen und der eigenen Stromerzeugung aus Wind- und Sonnenenergie.
 
Das schaffen wir allerdings nicht alleine, sondern dazu brauchen wir dich! Werde Teil unseres Teams und fordere den Status Quo heraus. Mit Energie, die gut für den Planeten ist und gut für dein Karma. 💚  Finde jetzt deinen Traumjob und werde Teil der Energierevolution von Octopus Energy Germany.

Business Development, Strategie, Projektmanagement – und das alles am liebsten gleichzeitig? Dann suchen wir genau dich. Als Chief of Staff (m/w/d) wirst du zur rechten Hand unserer CFO und zum Motor abteilungsübergreifender Projekte. Kein Tag wie der andere, kein Problem zu groß.

Deine Aufgaben:
  • Als Chief of Staff (m/w/d) arbeitest du eng mit unserer CFO und dem gesamten Management Team zusammen. Du diskutierst und hinterfragst strategische Entscheidungen, koordinierst nachhaltige Effizienzsteigerungen und steuerst abteilungsübergreifende Projekte oder stößt diese an
  • Du leitest funktionsübergreifende Initiativen, um die rechtzeitige Durchführung und den erfolgreichen Abschluss von Projekten sicherzustellen. Der Schwerpunkt liegt hierbei auf Wachstum, Skalierung und Innovation
  • Als Bindeglied zwischen Mitarbeiter*innen und Führungskräften hast du immer ein offenes Ohr. Über alle Teams und Hierarchie-Ebenen hinweg sorgst du mit direkter Kommunikation und einem regelmäßigen Austausch für ein produktives Arbeitsklima 
  • Zusammen mit unseren leitenden Angestellten behältst du die KPIs im Blick, um das Erreichen der Unternehmensziele sicherzustellen
  • Arbeite funktionsübergreifend über unsere Business Units hinweg um Herausforderungen zu identifizieren, Lösungsansätze zu formulieren und Veränderungen voranzutreiben
  • Du unterstützt bei einer Vielzahl an Themen, einschließlich End-to-End Projektmanagement, für unsere wichtigsten Geschäftsprioritäten. Du bist für strategische Schlüsselprojekte verantwortlich und hilfst dabei, die Gesamtstrategie des Unternehmens zu definieren

    • Dein Profil:
  • Dein wirtschaftswissenschaftliches Studium oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung bilden die Basis deiner fachlichen Kompetenz
  • Du hast mehrjährige Berufserfahrung (idealerweise als Chief of Staff) sowie fundierte Fachkenntnisse im Business Development oder in der Strategieentwicklung 
  • Du besitzt StartUp-Mentalität, fühlst dich in der dazugehörigen Arbeitsweise wohl und bist durch ein agiles und dynamisches Arbeitsumfeld beflügelt 
  • Neben deiner hohen Durchsetzungs- und Umsetzungsfähigkeit, verfolgst du einen proaktiven wie strukturierten Arbeitsansatz
  • Du hast ein ausgeprägtes Organisationstalent, starke Führungsqualitäten und die Fähigkeit, Teams zu inspirieren
  • Neben ausgeprägtem analytischem und konzeptionellem Denkvermögen, zeichnen dich zudem deine hohe Kommunikationsfähigkeit sowie dein gesunder Pragmatismus aus

Join the Future of Work ! Malt is Europe's leading freelance marketplace, connecting over 1,000,000 talented freelancers with 100,000+ companies. Founded in 2013, we're transforming how work gets done through our tech-powered, human-centered platform. What makes us different:
 
- A diverse team of 600 Malters across 6 European countries

Ready to help shape the future of work? Your next chapter starts here! 🪐

You will join Malt as a Customer Onboarding & Success Manager - Public Sector, based in Paris Manager Customer Success - Global, Public sector & SMB, you will work hand-in-hand and transversally with our Account Managers dedicated to the Public Sector.

 Your main mission will be to ensure the smooth deployment and flawless execution of framework agreements (accords-cadres) and public tenders throughout their lifecycle. jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager (F/H)
jobs.description:
At Younited, we believe credit and banking should feel as simple, fast and transparent as everything else in your digital life.

So we build financial services that way. We combine technology, data and automation to rethink the way people borrow, pay, save and manage their money.

Today, more than 1.5 million customers trust us, and nearly 500 employees contribute to our growth across 4 European countries.

What we build

    • Younited Credit – instant consumer credit, directly accessible to customers.
    • Younited Pay – instalment payment and financing solutions embedded into our partners' customer journeys.
    • Younited Cashback – cashback and personalised offers, enhanced by open banking data.
    • Younited Bank – our everyday banking offering, currently available through helios by Younited and being expanded.
Our ambition is to build a financial partner people genuinely trust, combining simplicity, transparency and responsible finance. As a certified B Corp, we integrate social and environmental considerations into the way we build our business.
 

The 5 values we work by

    • Make it simple - in the product, in the customer experience and in how we organise. Be transparent.
    • Act as an entrepreneur - take ownership, play as a team, dare to try and accept failure.
    • Innovate or die - challenge the status quo, however impossible it may seem.
    • Faster is better - speed over perfection, alignment over debate.
    • No limit - shoot for the moon, stay humble.
We give passionate problem-solvers the space to do their best work in diverse and inclusive teams across Europe, because that is how we build better financial products for our customers and partners.

Context 📄

How do you turn complex credit and payment products into propositions that customers understand, partners value and teams can sell?

As Product Marketing Manager at Younited, you will shape the insights, narratives and tools that help our products stand out and grow. You will work across Younited’s product portfolio, with Younited Pay as your initial priority given its strategic importance and the competitiveness of its market.

Within Marketing Central, you will join the Customer Engagement team and work with Product, Sales, Partnerships, Data, Brand & Communications and local marketing teams. Depending on business priorities, your scope may evolve across different Younited products, audiences and customer journeys.

Your mission will be to understand the audiences we want to reach, clarify what makes our products valuable and turn market, customer and field feedback into concrete recommendations for Sales, Partnerships, Product and Marketing. You will connect market reality, commercial priorities and product decisions by turning research, customer insights and field feedback into clear messages, useful tools and actionable recommendations. You will also work closely with the PRM/CRM teams to connect these insights with customer journeys, engagement and retention initiatives.

Key responsibilities 🚀

1) Build market and customer understanding

  • Conduct market research, competitive analysis and customer data analysis to identify target audiences, understand their needs, uncover opportunities and bring the voice of the customer into business and product decisions.

  • Work across several products, audiences and business priorities, with Younited Pay as the initial priority.

  • Work with the PRM/CRM and Customer Engagement teams on segmentation, use cases and customer journeys across acquisition, activation, repeat usage and retention, including merchant onboarding for Younited Pay and other priority journeys across the Younited portfolio.

2) Define positioning and support commercial teams

  • Clarify the benefits, differentiators and key messages of Younited products, making complex topics compelling and easy to understand for customers, merchants, partners and internal teams.

  • Turn market and customer insights into sales pitches, presentations, enablement materials, partner tools and practical recommendations that help Sales and Partnerships teams explain and sell our products.

  • Contribute to strategic RFPs by understanding requirements and shaping the response narrative, value proposition, differentiators, proof points and presentation materials.

3) Partner with Product teams and support product evolutions

  • Bring market feedback and customer insights into product discussions and roadmaps, and influence product decisions based on market and customer feedback.

  • Support product launches and evolutions with the necessary materials, including demos, training materials, operational guides, FAQs and sales enablement documents.

  • Work across Product, Sales, Partnerships, Data, Brand & Communications and local marketing teams to turn insights into clear messages, useful tools and actionable recommendations.

About you 👇

  • You have at least 5 years of experience in B2B Product Marketing, Product Marketing or a related role.

  • You know how to conduct market research, analyse competition and turn customer and market insights into clear, actionable recommendations.

  • You are comfortable working across several products, audiences and business priorities.

  • You understand Sales and Partnerships teams’ challenges and know how to create useful, practical materials that support commercial teams.

  • You are comfortable contributing to strategic RFPs and tailoring a value proposition to different business and partner contexts.

  • You are comfortable working with Product teams and influencing product decisions based on market and customer feedback.

  • Experience in payments, banking, credit, fintech, e-commerce or another complex or regulated industry is a plus.

  • You know how to make complex topics simple and compelling, both in writing and verbally.

  • You are fluent in French and English.

  • You are autonomous, structured, proactive and able to manage several projects in parallel.

  • You know how to adapt your approach to different audiences and switch between strategic thinking and hands-on execution.

  • You know how to influence stakeholders without relying on hierarchical authority and deliver concrete results.

Hiring process 📅

  • First video interview with Arthur, Lead Talent Acquisition Manager, to discuss the role, your motivations and Younited.

  • Second interview with Lise, Head of Customer Engagement, to explore the expectations of the role in greater depth.

  • Business case, followed by a debrief and conversations with members of the team.

  • Final interview with Ricardo, Growth & Business Operations Director, to validate overall alignment with the role and potential development opportunities.


🎁 Other benefits from joining Younited ?

  • Offices located in the heart of Paris (9th arrondissement)
  • An international work environment and the opportunity to go on assignments in our offices abroad (Barcelona, Lisbon, Rome)
  • An entrepreneurial mindset and strong team spirit
  • Personalized managerial and HR support during onboarding and throughout your Younited journey
  • A continuous learning environment with access to internal and external training, an e-learning platform, and “Friday workshops” within the Tech team to support everyone’s development
  • A strong focus on work-life balance
  • A parenthood charter to support all family-related projects, with key measures
  • Special leave for major life events, often more generous than legal requirements
  • An hybrid remote work policy: 2 to 3 days of remote work per week depending on the team, and the option to work fully remotely for one week twice a year
  • 33 days paid holiday, i.e. 8 more than the statutory 25 days (instead of the traditional RTT)
  • Access to the Wellpass platform (formerly Gymlib) with over 4,000 fitness and wellness activities across France at a discounted rate
  • Meal vouchers (€10 per day, 60% covered by the company)
  • Team buildings in France (Summer Party & Winter Party), abroad, and within your team
 
Younited is an Equal Opportunity Employer for any minority, disability, gender identity or sexual orientation.

jobs.title: Head of FP&A (F/H)
jobs.description:
About Younited

At Younited, we are reinventing credit and payments to make banking simple, transparent, and inclusive. European leader in instant credit, we serve over 1 million customers and partner with major brands like Apple, N26, Bouygues Telecom. Operating in 4 countries with 500 employees, we are proud to be B Corp certified, placing social and environmental impact at the heart of our strategy.

Our mission: become the trusted financial partner for millions of Europeans by promoting transparency and financial well-being. We leverage cutting-edge technology and innovation to redefine lending and payment practices, delivering exceptional user experience.

Our solutions include credit and payment services for consumers and partners. We empower passionate problem-solvers to collaborate, innovate, and act as entrepreneurs in a fast-growing environment.

In January 2025, we reached a major milestone in our history by becoming a publicly listed company on Euronext Paris and Amsterdam.

Join us and shape the future of finance in an inclusive, dynamic, and ambitious company.

Be part of an adventure that is only beginning!

About the Finance team

The Corporate Finance team reports to the Finance Director.

The Corporate Finance team oversees the financial reporting of Younited within a regulated banking environment. Its mission is (i) to deliver accurate accounting, tax, and regulatory reporting, (ii) provide reliable performance analyses to guide strategic decisions, partnering with business units to optimize resource allocation and support key growth initiatives, and (iii) drive the continued digital transformation of the overall finance function while working closely with teams across the company.

The FP&A team is being reorganised into an end-to-end function of 4 people, including the Head of FP&A. Each FP&A controller owns both the forecast and the actuals on their scope, across the full management cycle — budget, business plan and capital plan, monthly closing anticipation, and post-closing analytics analytics.

Context 📄

Reporting directly to the Finance Director, the Head of FP&A leads the newly structured FP&A function (a team of 3 FP&A controllers). He / She owns the management cycle and the calendar, arbitrates priorities and ad hoc requests, and acts as the guardian of the method and of the single planning model. He / She is accountable for the quality of the figures and for the development of the team.

This role comes at a pivotal moment: Younited is moving to a market-standard, end-to-end FP&A organization and the Head of FP&A will be responsible for shaping his/her team target operating model, formalise scopes and ways of working, and progressively automate and strengthen the reliability of the whole planning and reporting chain — while partnering closely with the business to turn financial analysis into better decisions.

Key responsibilities 🚀

  • Build the team target operating model, define the set of FP&A procedures (scopes, calendar, controls, documentation) and make its organisation resilient by design with clear back-ups and shared standards.
  • Own the budget process, business planning and reforecasts: annual budget (build, iterations, defence), multi-year business plan and periodic reforecasts, under one method and one single model.
  • Own the monthly closing process: pre-close anticipation of closing topics so that issues are spotted before the accounts are closed, post-close analysis of variances to budget, and capital plan.
  • Deliver timely, clear financial reporting tailored to each audience — leadership, local management and business partners — including management accounts, variance analyses and ad hoc studies, and act as a business partner to the divisions on strategic initiatives and performance improvement.
  • Lead, develop and coach the FP&A team, ensuring skills development, back-up and high performance across the scope.

About you 👇

  • Seasoned finance professional with 8+ years of experience, including team management:
    • with proven experience in both FP&A / controlling and Audit / TS at a leading international firm with exposure to financial institutions, regulated environments and complex data structures,
    • with a good understanding of a market standard full management cycle — budgeting, multi-year business planning, forecasting and management reporting,
    • experienced with EPM tools is a plus,
  • Solid understanding of accounting standards and their strategic implications for financial planning and reporting (IFRS & French GAAP & regulatory),
  • A structured leader able to build method and process, set standards and drive change and continuous improvement in an evolving environment,
  • Demonstrated ability to work under tight deadlines while ensuring accuracy and reliability,
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to interact confidently with business partners and top management (CEO, COO, CFO) and board,
  • A proactive, hands-on and detail-oriented mindset, with strong analytical skills and a genuine commitment to team development,
  • Full professional proficiency in English and French, both written and spoken, is required.

Why makes the role so exciting 🌟

  • A rare opportunity to build and lead a market-standard end-to-end FP&A function in a listed company.
  • High autonomy and visibility: you own one of the most critical processes of the company and partners directly with Senior Management personnel of the Company.

Recruitment process 📅

  1. The process begins with an interview with Arthur, Lead Talent Acquisition Manager, to discuss the role, your motivations, and how you align with Younited's values and culture (30 min).
  2. This is followed by an interview with Arthur, Finance Director, for a discussion about the position (1h).
  3. Next, you'll have one week to prepare a technical case study on an FP&A topic (management cycle, planning and business partnering), and then present your approach during a dedicated session (1h) with Arthur and a member of the Finance team.
  4. You will then meet Rémi, BU France CEO for a conversation about the banking business (1h).
  5. Finally, the process concludes with a closing conversation with Naren, Group CFO (1h).

jobs.title: Research Engineer
jobs.description:
Do you believe the path to general-purpose physical AI runs through noisy, real-world factory deployments?
Are you excited by the challenge of turning the classical robotic stacks into the foundational training data for physical AI?
Do you want to bridge the gap between world-class ML research and industrial-scale robotic execution?

If your answers are yes, we should talk.


At Nomagic, we are executing a humble pivot for general-purpose physical AI. We believe that physical AI is fundamentally a knowledge transfer problem - we are leveraging the "internet data" of robotics - massive deployment logs from real systems operating in production environments -  to bootstrap our efforts. We are looking for Research Engineers who will help us to build, train, and deploy foundational models that bring our fleet from a classical control stack to generalized AI mastery.


Offer essentials
  • Play with real robots, solving real problems, every day.
  • Relocation package.
  • Flexible working hours.
  • English-speaking environment.

    • Here is why we love this job ourselves, and hope you will enjoy it too:
  • We combine world-class research with top-notch engineering and apply it to solve real problems
  • The data already exists. We have robots in production at scale. We aren't waiting for datasets to be collected; the byproduct of our machines doing useful work is being created right now.
  • We measure what matters. We test our code in unit tests, simulations, and directly on real robots. Grounding our models in deployment allows us to truly measure performance.
  • High leverage, high impact. We’re still a highly focused team. If your training recipes improve our agents, you directly change the economics of the company.
  • World-class peers. Our team has built Google Warsaw, unicorn startups, led research in DeepMind, tested rocket engines, and worked at top companies like Nvidia and ByteDance. Now, we are shaping the reality of Physical AI together.
  • We are building the bridge. We aren't a new startup looking for an application; we are an established player bootstrapping physical AI. We believe that this will be the first true proof-of-concept for scaled physical AI.

    • What you will do
  • Your focus will be defined by the intersection of Robotics and ML and large-scale multimodal model training - expertise in both is optimal and alternatively eagerness to learn.
  • Expect challenges across two main pillars with the opportunity to specialise:
  • Core Research & Large-Scale Infrastructure
  • Own the Training Stack: Design, implement, and maintain the core infrastructure for large-scale VLA model training, including scheduling, distribution, job management, checkpointing, and rigorous logging.
  • Enable Rapid Iteration: Build the critical tools and abstractions necessary for launching, monitoring, debugging, and seamlessly reproducing complex, multi-variant experiments.
  • Train from Deployment Logs: Utilize our massive repository of offline, classical stack data to pre-train robust robot foundation models.
  • Drive the Software Feedback Loop: Translate core research needs into concrete infra capabilities, track experiments, analyze results, and close the loop directly with ML researchers to unblock model progress

jobs.title: Account Executive (Enterprise)
jobs.description:
About Dust

Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it.

With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done.

With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast.

We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026.

Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50.

Summary

Every large group in Europe has bought an AI assistant, or is buying one this year. The next decision is harder: how their teams' own work runs on agents, across their own systems, governed, on top of what they already pay for. That is what Dust sells, and this role owns that decision inside a handful of France's largest groups.

You will be one of our first Strategic Account Executives. We are looking for people who have been at the top of every team they have joined, wherever they started.

The Role

  • 5 to 8 named groups, 5,000+ employees, mostly headquartered in France. You own each relationship globally, across subsidiaries and countries.

  • Some are already customers. They started with one team and grow as more teams build their own agents. Their renewals are where your account grows, and you run them.

  • The others you open. We go in through the executive who owns the group's AI programme, before any tender is written. Our founders and executives work your accounts with you, and so do the consulting firms that run these programmes.

  • Deals of €300K to €1M+ a year, decided by the executive committee, with IT, security, procurement and the business in the room.

  • You run the deal team: solutions engineers, customer success, partners and founders, brought in when you decide.

  • You write the playbook. How Dust sells to large groups is being built now, by the people in this seat.

What success looks like

  • 90 days: an account plan for each group, the owner of the AI programme identified in all of them, and a first executive meeting held in at least half.

  • 12 months: a first group-level deal signed, and one existing account growing across new teams.

Who we are looking for

  • You have been at or near the top of every team you joined. Tell us your rank in each role, and where you started. We care more about how far you have come than about the logos on the way.

  • You have opened large accounts yourself, without a big brand or an inherited list doing the work.

  • You have led a deal decided at executive level, with procurement and legal involved, and you can walk us through every step of it.

  • You have grown an account after the first deal, and you think in what an account is worth in three years.

  • You use AI in your own work. If you have built an agent, show us.

  • Fluent French and English. Based in Paris or moving here, with regular travel in France and Europe.

We do not screen on years of experience or on the size of your last employer. If you have been the best at what you did and want a bigger game, apply.

What is hard

  • Our brand is smaller than the labs'. You will win on what Dust does next to the assistant a group already chose, not on our name.

  • Large groups move slowly and decide at the top. A unit that loves the product does not make a group deal; you will learn to find the person who does.

  • The playbook is unfinished. You will be writing it while you use it.

What you get

  • OTE €180k OTE 50/50 split, uncapped accelerators, and a significant equity package in a Sequoia-backed company.

  • Founders on your accounts, a small team that decides fast, and room to lead as the Strategic team grows. We are not promising a title; we will look here first when we need one.

  • Health cover, relocation support, Paris office, regular trips to San Francisco.

How we hire

A call with Talent, a deep dive on your largest deals with the hiring manager, a live executive meeting role-play, then a half-day where you present an account plan for a group of your choice, and a conversation with a founder. We decide within [2–3] weeks of your first call.

In your application, tell us your rank on your team in each of your last roles, and one deal you are proud of.

Location

We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together.

We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect.

That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call.

Why Dust

The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves.

We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast.

If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk.

Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

jobs.description:
Gestalte mit uns die Zukunft der Chipindustrie – von Anfang an!

Deine Rolle bei Black Semiconductor

Bei Black Semiconductor entwickeln wir eine neue Generation der Halbleitertechnologie. Mit unserer ersten Produktionsanlage FabOne in Aachen schaffen wir die Grundlage für die Chipfertigung der Zukunft.

Dafür suchen wir dich! Als Elektriker*in wirst du Teil unseres Facility-Teams und unterstützt den Aufbau, die Inbetriebnahme und den Betrieb der elektrotechnischen Infrastruktur unserer Produktionsanlage.

Über uns

Wir verstehen die Halbleiterindustrie als ein Universum voller Möglichkeiten. Wir erkennen Chancen und sehen das transformative Potenzial, das unsere Graphen-Lösungen für die Neugestaltung der Branche mit sich bringen.

Wir laden Dich ein, diesen Wandel gemeinsam mit uns voranzutreiben, indem wir kluge Köpfe mit einer gemeinsamen Vision zusammenbringen. Diese Vision ist es, zu zeigen, dass grundlegende Veränderungen möglich sind. Mit Deinem Wissen und Deinen Fähigkeiten kannst Du beweisen, dass Dinge anders – und besser – gemacht werden können.

Gemeinsam haben wir die Kraft, das Paradigma zu verändern, wie die Welt vernetzt ist.

Unsere Technology

Die steigenden Anforderungen der Halbleiterindustrie an leistungsfähigere Chips mit höherer Bandbreite und geringerem Energieverbrauch werden durch unsere Technologie adressiert. Wir ermöglichen die Verbindung von Chips mit Hochdurchsatz-Computernetzwerken bei minimaler Latenz.

Der entscheidende Faktor ist die Nutzung der einzigartigen physikalischen Eigenschaften von Graphen, um elektronische Datenverarbeitung mit photonischer Kommunikation zu vereinen. Dadurch können unzählige Chips miteinander interagieren, als wären sie ein einziges System. Unsere Graphen-Photonik-Innovation hebt Rechenleistung und Effizienz auf ein neues Niveau.

Kurz gesagt: Wir vernetzen Chips zu leistungsstarken, energieeffizienten Systemen und überwinden mit unserer Graphen-Technologie die bisherigen Grenzen der Konnektivität in der Halbleiterindustrie.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Aufbau, Installation und Inbetriebnahme der elektrotechnischen Infrastruktur unserer Produktionsanlage.

  • Wartung, Prüfung und Instandhaltung elektrischer Anlagen und Niederspannungssysteme.

  • Fehlersuche und Störungsbehebung an elektrischen Installationen und Steuerstromkreisen.

  • Lesen und Interpretieren von Stromlauf-, Schalt- und Verdrahtungsplänen.

  • Mitarbeit bei der Inbetriebnahme und Weiterentwicklung unserer Gebäudeautomation (FMCS), einschließlich Steuerungs- und Visualisierungssystemen.

  • Koordination und Unterstützung externer Elektrofachfirmen sowie Sicherstellung einer fachgerechten und sicheren Ausführung.

  • Unterstützung bei elektrischen Prüfungen, technischer Dokumentation und Materialbeschaffung.

Das bringst du mit

  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Elektroniker für Betriebstechnik, Automatisierungstechnik, Energie- und Gebäudetechnik oder eine vergleichbare elektrotechnische Qualifikation.

  • Praktische Erfahrung in der Elektroinstallation, Instandhaltung oder Betriebstechnik.

  • Gute Kenntnisse in der Elektrotechnik und Freude an praktischer Fehlersuche und Problemlösung.

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Stromlauf- und Schaltplänen.

  • Grundkenntnisse der relevanten elektrotechnischen Vorschriften und Sicherheitsbestimmungen.

  • Eine selbstständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und Freude an der Zusammenarbeit im Team.

  • Sehr Gute Deutschkenntnisse; Englischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil.

Unsere Arbeitskultur

Menschen stehen über Prozessen. Bei Black Semiconductor ist Flexibilität entscheidend. Wir sorgen dafür, dass sich die Arbeit dem Leben anpasst – und nicht umgekehrt. Wir setzen uns für eine ausgewogene Work-Life-Balance ein, in der berufliche Aufgaben sinnvoll und bereichernd sind. Unsere Prozesse sind auf den Menschen ausgerichtet und ermöglichen es dir, dich auf das Wesentliche zu konzentrieren.

Lass uns gemeinsam wachsen. Dein Potenzial steht für uns an erster Stelle. Wir bieten dir die Freiheit und Eigenverantwortung, nachhaltige Veränderungen zu bewirken, und fördern deine Entwicklung durch eine Kultur des kontinuierlichen Lernens. Wir investieren in deine berufliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung.

Deine Gesundheit und Zukunft sind uns wichtig. Dein Wohlbefinden hat für uns höchste Priorität. Wir bieten dir ein umfassendes Leistungspaket mit hervorragenden Versicherungsleistungen, betrieblicher Altersvorsorge und virtuellen Aktienoptionen – für deine mentale, körperliche und finanzielle Gesundheit. Deine Sicherheit und Zufriedenheit liegen uns heute und in Zukunft am Herzen.

Wir leben Offenheit. Zusammenarbeit und Inklusion bilden die Grundpfeiler unserer Unternehmenskultur. Wir fördern Offenheit und schaffen ein Umfeld, das von Vertrauen und gegenseitigem Respekt geprägt ist. Individualität ist unsere gemeinsame Stärke und treibt Innovation und Fortschritt voran.

Wir verbinden Chips – und Menschen. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen qualifizierter Menschen unabhängig von ihrer Herkunft und ihrem persönlichen Hintergrund. Wir schaffen ein inklusives und unterstützendes Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Zusammenarbeit, Innovation und persönliche Entwicklung großgeschrieben werden. Werde Teil unseres Unternehmens und gestalte mit uns den Wandel in der Halbleiterindustrie.

jobs.description:
Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots. 

Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment. 

Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry. 

The Gravis RACK is a machine-agnostic retrofit kit that adds autonomy to excavators and wheel loaders from 10 to 100+ tonnes: LiDAR and camera sensing, GNSS RTK, networking hardware and rugged edge compute that works offline. Paired with the Slate tablet and our Copilot software, it lets an operator run a machine manually, with AI assistance, or fully autonomously.  


About the role

At Gravis, we build high tech systems that give machine operators superhuman capabilities. To adapt in real time to changes in the environment the Gravis Rack fuses data from LiDAR, cameras, GNSS, and hydraulics into an autonomous control system. The robotics platform team builds the software foundation for our robots to enable non stop operation in the harshest environments. We ensure all algorithms execute correctly, based on a rock solid communication layer and world class introspection capabilities. We provide all the tools to deploy, develop and debug the most powerful robots on earth.

As a robotics platform software engineer intern, you will help build our vision of a scalable, safe and high performing robotics platform. You will  gather requirements from internal customers, work on communication layer, node orchestration and lifecycle management as well as APIs to off-machine systems.
